dashakTitleEnglish: Bhakti Nirupan (A Discourse on the Nine Forms of Devotion)
note: All 10 samas are fully populated and sourced. Original owi text and Marathi meaning from the ioustotra.blogspot.com 'Stotra (hymns)' blog (Prakash Ketkar); English meaning from John Norwell's 2015 translation. Every samas's owi count matches exactly between both independent sources with no gaps, duplicates, or numbering shifts. This dashak covers the classical Navadha Bhakti (nine-fold devotion: listening, singing praise, remembering the Name, service at the feet, worship, bowing down, servant-devotion, friendship, and total self-surrender), concluding with a tenth samas on the four kinds of liberation (Mukti Chatushtaya).

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: जयजय जी गणनाथा । तूं विद्यावैभवें समर्था । अध्यात्मविद्येच्या परमार्था । मज बोलवावें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रीजगाननाचा जयजयकार असो. सकळ विद्यानीं गजानन संपन्न आहे. अध्यात्मविद्येचा प्राण असलेला परमार्थ सांगण्याची शक्ती, स्फूर्ती त्याने मला द्यावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Victory to you, Oh Lord of counting (ganesh; from you numbers/counting and also zero comes). You are that non-dual Self due to your powerful and glorious understan- ding. This understanding of oneness you should `speak' to this `me'.

owis.original: नमूं शारदा वेदजननी । सकळ सिद्धि जयेचेनी । मानस प्रवर्तलें मननीं । स्फूर्तिंरुपें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शारदा वेदांची माता आहे. तिच्या कृपेने सर्व सिद्धी मिळतात. तिच्यामुळे अंतःकरणांत स्फूर्ति येऊन माझे मन चिंतनांत मग्न झाले. तिला मी नमस्कार करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: I bow to sharada, the mother of the vedas. Due to you, this `all' gets established. Due to this original inspiration, `I am', the mind settles in manana (ie. the constant remembrance of `I am').

owis.original: आतां आठऊं सद्गुरु । जो पराचाहि परु । जयाचेनि ज्ञानविचारु । कळों लागे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां मी सद्गुरुचे स्मरण करतो. तो परमात्म्याहूनही श्रेष्ठ आहे. ज्याच्यामुळे मला आत्मज्ञान प्राप्ती होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Now (with this `I am' understanding), sadguru is being remembered. Though He is beyond even this para `speech', still it is through this `I am' that, that thoughtless nirgun is understood.

owis.original: श्रोतेन पुसिलें बरवें भगवद्भजन कैसें करावें । म्हणौनि बोलिलें स्वभावें । ग्रन्थांन्तरीं ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांनी चांगला प्रश्र्ण केला की भगवद्भजन कसे करावें ? त्याचे उत्तर म्हणून निरनिराळ्या ग्रंथांतील भक्तीचे विचार मी येथे सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But if the listener wipes out this beautiful `I am' then, how can there be the bhajans of God? (how can you be ever present in every action?) Therefore this `speech' that is within the composition of words should be made (when the meaning conveyed by the words is understood then the mind becomes quiet, for it understands, the words are not the meaning). 1 siddharameshwar maharaj- Now ganesha (the isha-Lord of gana-numbers,) is concealed within this zero. He is therefore the Knower of zero and because He is its Lord, He is the Lord of all counting. He Himself cannot be counted but as soon as He starts counting, He forgets Himself and appears as a lowly jiva. However when He is able to remain as the witness of this zero then, He is its Lord and the Lord of this multitude of numbers. Thus ganesha is the beginning of this zero, the numbers and the gunas and He is the beginning of that formless/nirguna also.

owis.original: सावध होऊन श्रोतेजन । ऐका नवविधा भजन । सत्शास्त्रीं बोलिलें पावन । होईजे येणें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्तीचे नऊ प्रकार जे शास्त्रांत सांगितले आहेत ते श्रोत्यांनी लक्षपूर्वक ऐकावेत. त्यांच्याच आचरणाने माणुस पवित्र होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Oh listener within the mind, be very alert and listen to these nine forms of bhajan. Then this `speech' within the real *shasthra will be revealed and then on account of that thoughtless understanding, I do not exist, you will become pure. *(neti, neti: not this, not that)

owis.original: नवविधा भजन बोलिलें । तेंचि पुढें प्रांजळ केलें । श्रोतीं अवधान दिधलें । पाहिजे आतां ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हे जे नऊ प्रकार शास्त्रांत सांगितले आहेत त्यांचेच सविस्तर वर्णन मी पुढे करीत आहे. ते श्रोत्यांनी आतां सावधपणे ऐकले पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: By means of these nine forms of bhajan there is this `speech' and afterwards that Reality is clearly revealed. Now (be in the moment), the true listener must be constantly attentive.

owis.original: प्रथम भजन ऐसें जाण । हरिकथापुराणश्रवण । नाना अध्यात्मनिरुपण । ऐकत जावे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पहिले भगवंताचे भजन किंवा भक्ती म्हणजे श्रवण होय. म्हणजे भगवंताची कथा ऐकावी. पुराण ऐकावे. प्रवचने व अध्यात्म निरुपन ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Know the first bhajan is shravan and it is the listening to the `story' of *hari, that ancient one who is before everything. It is the listening to this spiritual discourse, `I am' when there are the `many' discourses. *(hari is vishnu, means to know)

owis.original: कर्ममार्ग उपासनामार्ग । ज्ञानमार्ग सिद्धांतमार्ग । योगमार्ग वैराग्यमार्ग । ऐकत जावे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कर्ममार्ग, उपासनामार्ग, ज्ञानमार्ग, सिद्धांतमार्ग, योगमार्ग, वैराग्यमार्ग ऐकत जावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: The path of action/karma, the path of worship/upasana, the path of knowledge/gnyan, the path of the Final Truth/siddhant, the path of union/yoga and the path of renunciation/vairagya are all the same when the mind listens to this `I am'.

owis.original: नाना व्रतांचे महिमे । नाना तीर्थांचे महिमे । नाना दानांचे महिमे । ऐकत जावे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या व्रतांचे महिमे, वेगवेगळ्या तीर्थांचे महिमे, निरनिराळी दाने त्यांचे महिमे ऐकत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' vows are this greatest of vows (`I am He'); the `many' pilgrimage places are this greatest of pilgrimage places and the `many' offerings are this greatest of of- ferings when there is this listening/shravan.

owis.original: नाना माहात्म्यें नाना स्थानें । नाना मंत्र नाना साधनें । नाना तपें पुरश्र्चरणें । ऐकत जावीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेगवेगळ्या आश्र्चर्यकारक गोष्टी, वेगवेगळी ठिकाणे, अनेक मंत्र, साधने, तपे, पुरःचरणे ऐकावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: Where are the `many' great people, the `many' places, the `many' mantras, the `many' sadhanas, the `many' penances and japas when you listen to this `speech'?

owis.original: दुग्धाहारी निराहारी । फळाहारी पर्णाहारी । तृणाहारी नानाहारी । कैसे ते ऐकवे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी नुसत्या दुधावर राहणारे, कोणी काहींच न खाणारे, कोणी नुसत्या फलाहारावर राहणारे, कोणी नुसते गवत खाऊन राहणारे, कोणी जे मिळेल ते खाणारे कसे ते ऐकत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the ones who live on milk or on water only; the ones who live on fruit and the ones who live on only leaves; when there are the ones who eat only grass and the ones who live in the `many', then how can there be this listening? (ie. in the animals this `I am' is ever present but it cannot be understood)

owis.original: उष्णवास जळवास । सीतवास आरण्यवास । भूगर्भ आणी आकाशवाास । कैसे ते ऐकावे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी उन्हांत राहणारे, कोणी पाण्यांत राहणारे, कोणी थंडींत राहणारे, कोणी अरण्यांत राहणारे, कोणी गुहेंत राहणारे, तर कोणी आकाशांत राहणारे कसे असतात ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the ones who live in the heat or the ones who live in the water; when there are the ones who live in the cold and the ones who live in the forest; when there are the ones who live in the caves of this earth, and the ones who live in the air, then how can there be this listening to `I am'?

owis.original: जपी तपी तामस योगी । नाना निग्रह हटयोगी । शाक्तआगम आघोरयोगी । कैसे ते ऐकावे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी जप करणारे, कोणी तप करणारे, तापट अघोरी योगी, कोणी देहावर निश्र्चयाने आवर घालणार हटयोगी, कोणी शाक्त, अघोरमार्गाचे शक्तीचे उपासक कसे ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the ones who do japa and the ones who make tapa/austerities; when there are the yogis of *tamo guna and hathayoga; when there are the ones who use the powerful mantras taught in the vedas (ie. brahmin priests) and the ones who perform black magic, then how can there be this listening to the `I am'? *(Some have strange and painful practices like, standing on one leg or with one hand raised etc.)

owis.original: नाना मुद्रा नाना आसनें । नाना देखणीं लक्षस्थानें । पिंडज्ञानें तत्वज्ञानें । कैसीं तें ऐकावीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी नाना मुद्रा, नानाआसने करुन त्यांत प्राविण्य मिळवणारे, कोणी नाना लक्ष्यांवर चित्त स्थिर करणारे, कोणी शरीरशास्त्र व विश्र्वरचना जाणणारे कसे ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' fixed attitudes/mudras and the `many' postures/asanas; when there are the `many' beautiful experiences at the various places of attention; when there is the knowledge of the physical body and the knowledge of the gross elements, then how can there be this listening? (Leave every concept and be shravan, the listening to this `I am')

owis.original: नाना पिंडांची रचना । नानाभूगोळ रचना । नाना सृष्टीची रचना । कैसीं तें ऐकावीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्राण्यांची शरीररचना, पृथ्वीवरील अनेक प्रदेशांची रचना, सृष्टींतील अनेक पशु, पक्षी, जलचर वगैरे प्राण्यांची रचना जाणणारे, कसे ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' is the construction of the pinda/individual body; the `many' is the construction of the great earth element (objectification and the giving of `many' names to the One nameless Self); and the `many' is the construction of this gross world of concepts and desires. When these are all here then, how can there be this listening?

owis.original: चंद्र सूर्य तारामंडळें । ग्रहमंडळें मेघमंडळें । येकवीस स्वर्गें सप्त पाताळें । कैसीं तें ऐकावीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चंद्र, सूर्य, तारामंडलें, ग्रहमंडलें, मेघमंडलें, एकवीस स्वर्ग, सप्त पाताळ कसे ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the moon, sun and the galaxy, the planets, the assembled clouds, twenty-one heavens and seven hells below us, then how can there be this listening? (To `listen' means to understand there is no moon, sun etc., there is only the one form and that is myself)

owis.original: ब्रह्माविष्णुमहेशस्थानें । इन्द्रदेवऋषीस्थानें । वायोवरुणकुबेरस्थानें । कैसीं तें ऐकावीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश, इन्द्र, देव, ऋषी, वायु, वरुण, कुबेर यांची स्थाने कशी, कोठे आहेत ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the place of brahma, vishnu and mahesh, when there is the place of indra, the gods and great sages; when there is the place of the wind, the lord of the sea and kuber, the lord of riches then, how can there be this listening?

owis.original: नव खंडे चौदा भुवनें । अष्ट दिग्पाळांची स्थानें । नाना वनें उपवनें गहनें । कैसीं तें ऐकावीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नऊ खंडे, चौदा भुवने, आठ दिक्पालांची स्थानें,  निरनिराळी दाट अरण्यें, उपवनें कशी आहेत. ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the nine continents, the fourteen worlds, the eight regents of eight directions; when there the `many' forests, orchards and hidden places; then how can there be this listening?

owis.original: गण गंधर्व विद्याधर । येक्ष किन्नर नारद तुंबर । अष्ट नायका संगीतविचार । कैसा तो ऐकावा ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शंकराचे गण, गंधर्व, विद्याधर, यक्ष, किन्नर, नारद, तुंबरु, अष्टनायक, संगीतशास्त्र याबद्दल माहीती ऐकावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the hosts of angels, and the gandharva, vidyadhara, yaksha, kin- nara/ celestial musicians; when there is narada (ie. mind) and tumbara (ie. the `many' concepts); when that thoughtless Self is a master of the eight forms of music and dance then, how can that atma be listening (how can there be this sagun `I am')?

owis.original: रागज्ञान ताळज्ञान । नृत्यज्ञान वाद्यज्ञान । अमृतवेळ प्रसंगज्ञान । कैसें तें ऐकावें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संगीतामधिल राग, ताल, वाद्यें, व नृत्य यांचे ज्ञान, चांगले मुहूर्त व चांगली वेळ आणि निरनिराळे प्रसंग यांचे ज्ञान ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the knowledge of raga (the songs of various emotions) and the knowledge of musical measures; when there is the knowledge of dance and the knowledge of musical instruments; when there is the auspicious period and the knowledge of ad- verse times then, how can that Reality be listening?

owis.original: चौदा विद्या चौसष्टी कळा । सामुद्रिक लक्षणें सकळ कळा । बत्तिस लक्षणें नाना कळा । कैशा त्या ऐकाव्या ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चौदा विद्या, चौसष्ट कला, हातावरील रेषांची लक्षणें, उत्तम माणसाच्या अंगी विलसणारी बत्तीस लक्षणें, सर्व कला यांची माहिती ऐकावी
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the fourteen branches of knowledge and the sixty-four arts; when due to the attention of the three gunas, there is palmistry etc. (all things related to body consciousness) then this `all' becomes one of the `many' arts; when due to this attention there is the knowledge of teeth etc. and the skills of the `many' then, how can that atma be listening to this sagun `speech'?

owis.original: मंत्र मोहरे तोटके सिद्धी । नाना वल्ली नाना औषधी । धातु रसायण बुद्धी । नाडिज्ञानें ऐकावीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मंत्र, औषधी, तोडगे, सिद्धी, नाना वल्ली, नाना औषधी, धातु, रसायने तयार करण्याची क्रिया, नाडी परीक्षा या गोष्टी ऐकाव्या.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are mantras, medicinal gems and charms and divine powers; when there are the `many' herbs and the `many' medicines; when there is alchemy and chemistry and when the intellect/buddhi can diagnose by the feel of the pulse (body conviction and not atma conviction), then one should listen (for there is only He in the world).

owis.original: कोण्या दोषें कोण रोग । कोणा रोगास कोण प्रयोग । कोण्या प्रयोगास कोण योग । साधे तो ऐकावा ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कफ, वात, पित्त या दोषांपैकी कोणत्या दोषाने कोणता रोग होतो. तो रोग बरा होण्यास कोणता प्रयोग करावा. व तो करण्यास योग्य काल कोणता हे ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: What is the disorder? What is the disease? What is the medicine for a particular disease? What is the combination of the medicines? When all these questions arise then, that atma should simply listen. (Leave off any care for this body and world)

owis.original: रवरवादि कुंभपाक । नाना यातना येमलोक । सुखदुःखादि स्वर्गनर्क । कैसा तो ऐकावा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नरकांतील रवरवादि, कुंभीपाक, तेथील नाना यातना यमलोक, स्वर्गांतील सुख, नरकांतील दुःख कसे ते ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this crowded and swarming hell (ie. gross world) and the hells of this `water-jug' (the gross body); when there are the `many' punishments of the world of death and the pains and pleasures of hell and heaven; then how can that atma be listening?

owis.original: कैशा नवविधा भक्ती । कैशा चतुर्विधा मुक्ती । कैसी पाविजे उत्तम गती । ऐसें हें ऐकावें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्तीचे नऊ प्रकार, सलोकता, समीपता, सरुपता व सायुज्यता या चार मुक्ति, उत्तम गति मिळण्याचा मार्ग हें सर्व ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: First ask, what are the nine forms of devotion/bhakti and what are the four kinds of freedom/moksha and how can one attain that highest state? Then that thoughtless Self can listen (only if you truly seek to understand, who is God and who am I, will these be revealed. If your time is spent thinking about the world then, your knowledge will be of this world only)

owis.original: पिंडब्रह्मांडाची रचना । नाना तत्वविवंचना । सारासारविचारणा । कैसी ते ऐकावी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडविचार, ब्रह्मांडविचार, अनेक तत्वांचे विवेचन, सारासार विचार कसा तें ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the formation of the individual body/pinda and the gross cre- ation/brahmanda and there is the investigation of the `many' gross elements; but when that thoughtless understanding of the *essence/non-essence is understood then, why would that Reality listen? (Listening to this `I am' has also to be left aside. Listening is the non-essence and it will reveal that essence, I am not)

owis.original: सायोज्यता मुक्ती कैसी होते । कैसें पाविजे मोक्षातें । या कारणें नाना मतें । शोधित जावीं ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सायोज्यता मुक्ति कशी होते, मोक्ष कसा मिळतो याविषयीं विवेचन करणारी नाना मते शोधावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: What is sayujya mukti/Final Liberation and how can that be acquired? By means of this sagun `speech', the `many' opinions should be searched through and purified.

owis.original: वेद शास्त्रें आणि पुराणें । माहावाक्याचीं विवरणें । तनुचतुष्टयनिर्शनें । कैसीं ते ऐकावीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेद, शास्त्रे, पुराणें, महावाक्यांवरील भाष्यें, चार देहांच्या निरसनाचें वर्णन ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the vedas, shasthras and puranas (they introduce the principle of oneness between the individual atma and that universal atma of shiva or brahman) and there is the investigation of the four great statements by vedanta (eg. tattwasmi `Thou are that'; and finally the last great statement says, knowledge is also not true). But when these bring about the negation of the four bodies then, why should that Reality listen any further?

owis.original: ऐसें हें अवघेंचि ऐकावें । परंतु सार शोधून घ्यावें । असार तें जाणोनि त्यागावें । या नांव श्रवणभक्ती ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें सर्व गोष्टी ऐकाव्या. त्यावरील तत्वांश शोधून त्याचे ग्रहण करावे. जें असार व निरुपयोगी असेल त्याचा त्याग करावा. याला श्रवणभक्ती असे म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self is the `many' sadhanas then, one should listen to this `I am' and then that thoughtless essence should be searched out and accepted. When that Reality is knowing then, there is this non-essence (`I am') and therefore this `I am' of shravan/knowing should also be given up.

owis.original: सगुणाचीं चरित्रें ऐकावीं । कां तें निर्गुण अध्यात्में शोधावीं । श्रवणभक्तीचीं जाणावीं । लक्षणें ऐसीं ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताची सगुण अवतारांची वर्णन म्हणजे त्याचे चरित्रे व  त्याच्या निर्गुण स्वरुपाचें वर्णन म्हणजे तत्वमीमांसा होय. ही श्रवणभक्ती लक्षणें होत.
owis.englishMeaning: When one listens to this sagun action then, how is that nirgun being accepted? Still, first that One should know by means of shravan.

owis.original: सगुण देवाचीं चरित्रें । निर्गुणाचीं तत्वें यंत्रें । हे दोनी परम पवित्रें । ऐकत जावीं ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाची सगुण चरित्रे व निर्गुणाची तत्वे दोन्ही परम पवित्र आहेत. ती ऐकत जावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the accomplishment of this sagun and that nirgun of God and there are these gross elements and these `many' instruments (ie. bodies). Therefore that thou- ghtless Supreme within this sagun/nirgun (prakruti/purush) should listen.

owis.original: जयंत्या उपोषणें नाना साधनें । मंत्र यंत्र जप ध्यानें । कीर्ति स्तुती स्तवनें भजनें । नानाविधें ऐकावीं ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगुणाच्या बाबतींत जयंत्या, उपोषणे, अनेक साधने, यंत्र, मंत्र जप, ध्यान,कीर्तिवर्णन, स्तुतिगायन, स्तोत्रें, भजनें अशी आहेत. ती ऐकावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: There is celebrating the Saint's birth; there is the performance of fasts and the making of puja; there are the various meditations on the `many' mantras and symbols and there is japa also. But it is due to this bhajan of shravan that one becomes pervasive and vast and one's praises get sung. Therefore the mind should simply listen. (Listening to this `I am' is the best of all these `many' sadhanas)

owis.original: ऐसें श्रवण सगुणाचें । अध्यात्मनिरुपण निर्गुणाचें । विभक्ती सांडून भक्तीचें । मूळ शोधावें ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तात्पर्य सगुणाच्या चरित्राचे श्रवण करावें. निर्गुणरुपाचे ज्ञान करुन घ्यावे. आपले वेगळेपण सोडून एक रुपता साधेल असे बघावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this listening/shravan to sagun then, there can be that nirgun dis- course of Oneness. By leaving aside non-devotion (ie. to be another and worship) that root of devotion/no-otherness can be searched out.

owis.original: श्रवणभक्तीचें निरुपण । निरोपिलें असे जाण । पुढें कीर्तन भजनाचें लक्षण । बोलिलें असे ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रवणभक्तीचे निरुपण केले. पुढील समासी किर्तन व भजन यांचे लक्षण सांगितले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Know this first devotion of shravan and then ahead there can be kirtana. This also is the `speech', `I am'. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Kirtan Bhakti (Devotion through Singing God’s Praise)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: श्रोतीं भगवद्भजन पुसिलें । तें नवविधा प्रकारें बोलिलें । त्यांत प्रथम श्रवण निरोपिलें । दुसरें कीर्तन ऐका ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोत्यांनी भगवद्भजन म्हणजे काय असे विचारले. त्या भगवद्बजनाचे नऊ प्रकार आहेत. असे सांगितले त्यापैकी श्रवण सांगितले. आतां कीर्तन ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener asked the question, what are these *bhajans of God? The answer is, this `speech' has nine forms. Of these the first bhajan is shravan and that has been discour- sed. Listen carefully and there will be the second bhajan, this is kirtana. *(Worship)

owis.original: सगुण हरिकथा करावी । भगवत्कीर्ति वाढवावी । अखंड वैखरी वदवावी । येथायोग्य ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताच्या सगुण चरित्राच्या कथा सांगून भगवंताची कीर्ति वृद्धीगंत करावी. त्यासाठी आपली वाणी योग्यरीतीने बोलती ठेवावी.
owis.englishMeaning: The sagun `story' of hari should be told (ie. forget everything and knowledge is there); the pervasiveness of God should be expanded; this `I am' is the gross utterance of that unbroken parabrahman and that should be made to grow.

owis.original: बहुत करावें पाठांतर । कंठीं धरावें ग्रन्थांतर । भगवत्कथा निरंतर । करीत जावी ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ पाठांतर करावे. पुष्कळ ग्रंथांचे तात्पर्य लक्षांत ठेवावे. आणि नेहमी भगवंताची कथा सांगावी.
owis.englishMeaning: The inner meaning of the scriptures, neti, neti, should be held in the throat (it is said that the throat is the place where a definite thought takes form and then it gets spoken aloud; but by the practice of neti, neti this `I am' or para speech will get established there). This is knowledge and it is the inner support of all worldly thinking and living. And while telling this `story' of God, that thoughtless parabrahman can then be realized.

owis.original: आपुलिया सुखस्वार्था । केलीच करावी हरिकथा । हरिकथेविण सर्वथा । राहोंचि नये ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या सुखासाठी, आनंदासाठी परत परत हरिकथा करावी. ती केल्याशिवाय राहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: To gain that bliss of your own Self, you have to tell this `story' of hari over and over again. No-where should remain without this `story' of hari.

owis.original: नित्य नवा हव्यास धरावा । साक्षेप अत्यंतचि करावा । हरिकीर्तनें भरावा । ब्रह्मगोळा अवघा ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या कथेमध्ये दरवेळी नविनपणा आणण्याचा प्रयत्न करावा. तोच तोचपणा टाळावा. हरिकीर्तनाने सर्व विश्र्व भरुन टाकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Have the desire for that Eternal and ever new in your mind; have such earnestness that everything in the universe is full with this song of hari/`I am He'.

owis.original: मनापासून आवडी । जीवापासून अत्यंत गोडी । सदा सर्वदा तांतडी । हरिकीर्तनाची ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कीर्तनाची मनापासून आवड असावी. जीवापासून भगवंताची गोडी असावी. नेहमी कीर्तनाची ओढ असावी.
owis.englishMeaning: The mind should have a love for this; the jiva should have a deep longing for this. Always and everywhere, there should be the urgent need for this `song' of hari (this effortless knowing).

owis.original: भगवंतास कीर्तन प्रिये । कीर्तनें समाधान होये । बहुत जनासी उपाये । हरिकीर्तनें कलयुगीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताला कीर्तन अत्यंत प्रिय आहे. कीर्तनाने भक्ताला व श्रोत्यांना कलीयुगामध्ये समाधान मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: God loves kirtana and due to kirtana there is the complete contentment of that thoughtless Self. This `all' of knowledge is the remedy for the restless mind and in this kali era (ie. in body consciousness) this is achieved by the making of kirtana.

owis.original: विविध विचित्रें ध्यानें । वर्णावीं आळंकार भूषणें । ध्यान मूर्ति अंतःकरणें । लक्षून कथा करावी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताची जीं निरनिराळी सगुण रुपें, त्यांचे ध्यान,रुप, अलंकार, भूषणें यांचे वर्णन कथा-कीर्तनांत आवर्जुन करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: By meditating on His wondrous form (`I am everywhere'), you sing His praise and decorate Him in all His finery. When your antah-karana places its attention on making this `story' then, it is meditating on Him. (The one thing which everyone has is the sense that they exist. Leave off all other thoughts, stop focusing your attention outside and meditate on this sense of your own presence, nothing else)

owis.original: येश कीर्ति प्रताप महिमा। आवडीं वर्णावा परमात्मा । जेणें भगवद्भक्तांचा आत्मा । संतुष्ट होये ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताचे यश, त्याची कीर्ति, त्याचा प्रताप महिमा अत्यंत प्रेमाने वर्णन करावा. त्यामुळे भगवद्भक्तांना आत्मिकसुख मिळेल.
owis.englishMeaning: Victory, pervasiveness, courage and power are the expressions of that paramatma. Due to these, that atma of the devotee will find its rest.

owis.original: कथा अन्वय लापणिक । नामघोष करताळिका । प्रसंगे बोलाव्या अनेका । धात माता नेमस्त ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कथानकें कथेमध्ये सुसंगत गुंफावीत. शब्दांवर कोट्या कराव्या. भगवंताच्या नावाचा जयजयकार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `story' is searched out then, there is the utterance of God's `name'. Due to this `I am' connection, the `many' fables about the `many' different shapes do not get told.

owis.original: ताळ मृदांग हरिकीर्तन । संगीत नृत्य तान मान । नाना कथानुसंधान । तुटोंचि नेदावें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: टाळ, मृदंग, गायन, नृत्य, ताना वगैरे, यांचा सर्वांचा उपयोग कीर्तन करताना करावा. परंतु हे करतांना कथेचा धागा तुटून देऊ नये.
owis.englishMeaning: With *cymbals and drum this `story' of hari should be sung and this should be accompanied with loving and reverential dancing (`I move in all'). Once the mind has been connected to this `story' it should never again be severed. *(We play the cymbals to keep the rhythm of our bhajan; they are a metaphor for always remembering your swarup).

owis.original: करुणाकीर्तनाच्या लोटें । कथा करावी घडघडाटें । श्रोतयांची श्रवणपुटें । आनंदे भरावी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कथेमध्ये करुणरसाचा उपयोग करुन श्रोत्यांचे कान आनंदाने भरुन धडकून कथा-कीर्तन करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When the power of this pervasiveness roars like thunder then, the heart of the one who `listens' will overflow with bliss.

owis.original: कंप रोमांच स्फुराणें । प्रेमाश्रुसहित गाणें । देवद्वारीं लोटांगणें । नमस्कार घालावे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कथा सांगतांना सात्विक भावानें मन भरुन जावें, शरीर कंप पावणें, अंगावर शहारे, प्रेमाश्रु वाहाणे, इत्यांदी अनावर होऊन देवाला साष्टांग नमस्कार घालावा.
owis.englishMeaning: You should sing with deep emotion, with tears of ecstasy and great love; you should bow down before the door of God again and again and again (surrender the body to this `all'/knowledge).

owis.original: पदें दोहडे श्र्लोक प्रबंद । धाटी मुद्रा अनेक छंद । वीरभाटिंव विनोद । प्रसंगें करावे ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कथेमधील प्रसंगवर्णन करतांना पदें, दोहे, श्लोक, प्रबंध, धाटी, मुद्रा वगैरे कवितेचे अनेक प्रकार वापरावेत. त्याचप्रमाणे भाटांनी रचलेले वीररसाचे पोवाडे म्हणावे, हास्यरसाचा वापर करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If there are the `many' different longings and if your attention is on the numerous different forms; if there are heroic speeches and humorous anecdotes still, you should not forget this sagun connection.

owis.original: नाना नवरासिक श्रृंगारिक। गद्यपद्याचें कौतुक । नाना वचनें प्रस्ताविक। शास्त्राधारें बोलावीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कथेमध्ये शृंगारासह नवरस असावेत. उत्तम गद्य व पद्य असावे, प्रसंगाला योग्य असणारी व शास्त्राचा आधार असणारी वचनें सांगावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: Even when your mind has a fondness and attraction for the play of the nine emotions (anger, passion, laughter etc.) still, this wonder of `I am' is there. So if you speak this divine `word' and take its support then, these `many' talks will repent.

owis.original: भक्तिज्ञानवैराग्यलक्षण । नीतिन्यायस्वधर्मरक्षण । साधनमार्ग अध्यात्मनिरुपण । प्रांजळ बोलावें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्ति, ज्ञान, व वैराग्य यांचे लक्षण काय, नीति, न्याय व स्वधर्म यांचे रक्षण कसे करावें, साधनामार्ग कसा असतो, आणि परमात्मस्वरुप कसे आहे. हे कीर्तनांत सांगावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The attention that brings this `I am' is called devotion/bhakti and it is called knowledge/gnyan and renunciation/vairagya too. This attention is the protection of truthfulness, justice and *swadharma. This `I am' should be called a spiritual discourse and this sadhana should be clearly `spoken'. *(One's own dharma, to stay in one's swarup).

owis.original: प्रसंगे हरिकथा करावी । सगुणीं सगुणकीर्ति धरावी । निर्गुणप्रसंगे वाढवावी । अध्यात्मविद्या ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रसंग जसा तशी हरिकथा सगुणरुपाची करावी. निर्गुणी प्रसंगी शुद्ध परमार्थस्वरुप सांगावे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `story' of hari is the establishing of the all-pervasiveness of that pure sattwa guna. This will bring the nirgun connection and that understanding of non-duality should be made to grow.

owis.original: पूर्वपक्ष त्यागून सिद्धांत । निरुपण करावें नेमस्त । बहुधा बोलणें अव्यावेस्त । बोलोंचि नये ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विषय मांडतांना पूर्वपक्ष सोडावा. सिद्धांत सांगावा. तो निश्र्चितपणे विवेचनकरुन सांगावा. बोलणे अव्यवस्थित नसावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this hypothesis (`I am everywhere') is left aside then, there is the making of that siddhant/Truth (I do not exist). But if this `speech' gets repeated by the mind then, it only becomes confused and disorderly and it should not be spoken (first leave aside the scattered thoughts of your mind and listen to this `speech').

owis.original: करावें वेदपारायेण । सांगावें जनासी पुराण । मायाब्रह्मीचें विवरण । साकल्य वदावें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेदांताचा अभ्यास करावा. लोकांना पुराण सांगावे. माया व ब्रह्म यांचें स्वरुप सर्व अंगांनी स्पष्ट सांगावे.
owis.englishMeaning: You should be devoted to this knowledge and then this expanded mind should be absorbed in that ancient Self. Such investigation discovers that unity of maya and brahman and that should be openly declared.

owis.original: ब्राह्मण्य रक्षावें आदरें । उपासनेचीं भजनद्वारें । गुरुपरंपरा निर्धारें । चळोंच नेदावी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्राह्मण धर्माचे पालन व रक्षण करावे. भगवंताची उपासनेची साधने आदराने रक्षावी. आपण गुरुपरंपरा निश्र्चयाने टिकवून ठेवावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Respect for the brahmin (Knower of brahman) should be protected and so He should be worshipped by the means of this bhajan. Such understanding is a gift from your guru and therefore it should be firmly established and never allowed to move.

owis.original: करावें वैराग्यरक्षण । रक्षावें ज्ञानाचें लक्षण । परम दक्ष विचक्षण । सर्वहि सांभाळी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वैराग्याचे रक्षण करावे. आत्मज्ञानाच्या लक्षणांचा अभ्यास करावा व त्यांचे रक्षण करावे. अधिक सावध राहावे व विवेकाने सर्व सांभाळावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Renunciation means this attention of knowledge and you should protect it always (attention cannot be placed upon the nirgun, for He is attentionless). By ardent alert- ness this `all' should be wisely cared for.

owis.original: कीर्तन ऐकतां संदेह पडे । सत्य ाच्यातें उडे । नीतिन्यायसाधन मोडे । ऐसें न बोलावें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कीर्तन ऐकतांना श्रोत्यांच्या मनांत संशय निर्माण होईल व सत्य न समजून त्यांचे समाधान होणार नाही. नीतिन्यास मोडेल व साधन सुटेल असे काहीं बोलू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Your kirtana should not allow body consciousness to arise nor should your listening to this `song' allow that contentment of the Truth fly away. Your kirtana should never break this sadhana of that which is right and just.

owis.original: सगुणकथा या नाव कीर्तन । अद्वैत म्हणिजे निरुपण । सगुण रक्षून निर्गुण । बोलत जावें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताच्या सगुण चरित्रकथेला कीर्तन हें नांव आहे. अद्वैताचे विवेचन आणि प्रतिपादन करणें यास निरुपण म्हणतात. हरिदासानें सगुणाचे महत्व सांभाळून निर्गुणाचे प्रतिपादन करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: This sagun `story' should be called kirtana and non-duality should be called the true discourse. By protecting this sagun `speech' there is that non-dual nirgun.

owis.original: असो वगत्रूत्वाचा अधिकार । अल्पास न घडे सत्योत्तर । वक्ता पाहिजे साचार । अनुभवाचा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणुस अनुभवाने, विद्येने, विचाराने आणि व्यासंगाने कमी आहे,त्याला वक्तृत्वाचा अधिकार नसतो. वक्ता स्वानुभव संपन्न असला पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: If you are to be a worthy recipient of this `speech' then, you should never converse with this small mind (then there will be no mindless chatter) and the `speaker' should achieve the true `experience' (`I only always am').

owis.original: सकळ रक्षून ज्ञान सांगे । जेणें वेदज्ञान न भंगे । उत्तम सन्मार्ग लागे । प्राणीमात्रांसी ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो अनुभवी वक्ता असतो, कोणाचाही बुद्धिभेद न करता ज्ञान सांगतो. वेदांची आज्ञा भंगणार नाही याची काळजी घेतो. आणि माणसांना उत्तम सन्मार्ग लागेल असे ज्ञान देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you carefully protect this `all' it will bring about the dissolution of this knowledge. For if you maintain this understanding `I am' then, the hidden presence of the Knower of this `I am' will become apparent (that witnessing purush is always there but He cannot be known for He is yourself. maharaj- how to kiss yourself?). Then you should be that Witness and pervade the whole prana (ie. first drop the thoughts of this world and body and be this `I am' of knowledge; then detach yourself from this `all' body and be its Witness).

owis.original: असो हे सकळ सांडून । करावें गुणानुवादकीर्तन । या नाव भगवद्भजन । दूसरी भक्ती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. हे सर्व राहूं द्यावें, ज्यामध्ये भगवंताच्या गुणांचे वर्णन करावे. त्याला भगवद्भजन म्हणतात. भक्तीचा हा दुसरा प्रकार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then let that thoughtless Self continuously drop the pervasiveness of this `all' guna (pure sattwa) and never take the touch. This `I am' is the bhajan of God and it is kirtana.

owis.original: कीर्तनें माहा दोष जाती । कीर्तनें होये उत्तम गती । कीर्तनें भगवत्प्राप्ती । येदर्थीं संदेह नाही ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कीर्तनानें मोठ मोठी पापें नाहीशी होतात. उत्तम गति प्राप्त होते. भगवंताची प्राप्ती होते. यांत काहीं संशय नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: By kirtana/pervasiveness, the `great sin' (maharaj- the only sin is to be a body) is dropped and by kirtana the highest state is achieved. By kirtana God is attained and there is no body consciousness.

owis.original: कीर्तनें वाचा पवित्र । कीर्तनें होये सत्पात्र । हरिकीर्तनें प्राणीमात्र । सुमिळ होती ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कीर्तनाने वाणी पवित्र होते. कीर्तनाने माणूस भगवंताला सत्पात्र होतो. तो शीलवान, चारित्र्यवान बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: By kirtana this `speech' is purified. By kirtana/pervasiveness one becomes worthy to accept that great gift. By the pervasiveness of hari the whole prana is full of virtue (then inside and outside, `I am there').

owis.original: कीर्तनें अवेग्रता घडे । कीर्तनें निश्र्चये सांपडे । कीर्तनें संदेह बुडे । श्रोतयांवक्तयांचा ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कीर्तनाने एकाग्रता साधते. भगवंताबद्दल निष्ठा वाढते. कीर्तनाने श्रोते व वक्ता या दोघांचा संशय नाहीसा होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: By kirtana the mind is quiet. By kirtana firm conviction is acquired. By kirtana the body consciousness of the speaker and the listener fly away. (That speaker of this `I am' and the listener to this `I am' are you only, but they have been drowned by worldly thoughts)

owis.original: सदा सर्वदा हरिकीर्तन । ब्रह्मसुत करी आपण । तेणें नारद तोचि नारायेण । बोलिजेत आहे ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेवांचा मुलगा नारद नेहमी भगवंताचे कीर्तन करतो. म्हणुन त्याला सर्व लोक नारायण म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When always and everywhere you sing this song of hari then, you are the son of brahman. Due to this `speech', narada (the mind) becomes narayana (God).

owis.original: म्हणोनि कीर्तनाचा अगाध महिमा । कीर्तनें संतोषे परमात्मा । सकळ तीर्थें आणी जगदात्मा । हरिकीर्तनीं वसें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणुन कीर्तनाचा महिमा अगाध आहे. त्यामुळे परमात्म्याला आनंद होतो. कीर्तनामध्ये सर्व तीर्थे व जगदात्मा राहतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore the greatness of kirtana is truly unfathomable. By this kirtana, that Supreme Self is contented. This pilgrimage place of the `all' and that `atma of the world' stay in this kirtana (ie. the known prakruti or witnessed and the Knower purush or Witness are present in kirtana). Note: maharaj- become so big that finally you go off .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Nam Smaran Bhakti (Devotion through Remembering the Name)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां निरोपिलें कीर्तन । जें सकळांस करी पावन । आतां ऐका विष्णोःस्मरण । तिसरी भक्ती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागीाल समासांत सर्वांना पवित्र करणारे व उत्तम गति देणाारे कीर्तन सांगितले. आता भगवंताची तिसरी भक्ति नामस्मरण ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously there was this discourse of kirtana. This is the purifier of the `all'. Now, listen and there will be this third devotion, it is remembering of lord vishnu.

owis.original: स्मरण देवाचें करावें । अखंड नाम जपत जावें । नामस्मरणें पावावें । समाधान ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचे स्मरण करावे. त्याचे नाव अखंड जपावे. नामस्मरण करुन समाधानी व्हावे.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be the remembrance of God; His *`name' should be constantly repeated. By the remembrance of His `name', that complete contentment of nirgun is acquired. *(maharaj- `name'/nam means na, not and aham/I am)

owis.original: नित्य नेम प्रातःकाळीं । माध्यानकाळीं सायंकाळीं । नामस्मरण सर्वकाळीं । करीत जावें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नित्य नेमाने प्रातःकाळी, दुपारी व सायंकाळी नामस्मरण करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Every day, in the morning time, in the middle of the day and in the night time, the remembering of this `name' should be going on. (maharaj- `the light shines from within you, you are the light': when you awake don't let the thoughts of the day ahead arise; understand that, I am the light that gives rise to all these thoughts; no thought, no world)

owis.original: सुख दुःख उद्वेग चिंता । अथवा आनंदरुप असतां । नामस्मरणेंविण सर्वथा । राहोंच नये ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सुख असो, दुःखी प्रसंग असो, मन उद्विग्न झालेले असो वा चिंतेंत असो, नामस्मरण सर्वकाळ, सर्व प्रसंगी करीत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not remain without taking this `name'; whether in happiness, pain, depression, worry or when there is bliss.

owis.original: हरुषकाळीं विषमकाळीं । पर्वकाळीं प्रस्तावकाळीं । विश्रांतिकाळीं निद्राकाळीं । नामस्मरण करावें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आनंदकाळी, कठीण काळी, पर्व काळ असो किंवा योग्य काळ असो, विश्रांती अथवा झोपेची वेळ असो नामस्मरण करीत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The remembering of this `name' should be continued during the times of enjoyment, during the times of difficulties, during auspicious festival days, at the time of rest and at the time of going to sleep.

owis.original: कोडें सांकडें संकट । नाना संसारखटपट । आवता लागतां चटपट । नामस्मरण करावें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा कठीण प्रसंग असो, कांहीं अडचण आलेली असो, एखद्या संकटांत सापडलेले असो, संसारांतील अनेक खटपटी असोत किंवा मनाला कसली तरी चुटपुट लागलेली असो, आपण नामस्मरण करीत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: There may be problems, awkward situations or even calamities; there may be the busy activities and worries of the `many', but still there should be the remembrance of this `name' (ie. everything is appearing upon myself and I have nothing at all to do with this).

owis.original: चालतां बोलतां धंदा करितां । खातां जेवितां सुखी होतां । नाना उपभोग भोगितां । नाम विसरों नये ॥ ७
owis.marathiMeaning: चालतांना, बोलतांना, धंदा करतांना, खातांना, जेवतांना, सुखी असतां किंवा नाना उपभोग भोगतांना नाम घ्यावयास विसरु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not forget this `name' of God while walking, while talking, while do- ing business, while eating, while breathing and while enjoying the fruits of past one's actions. One should not forget this `name' even while enjoying the pleasure of sexual union.

owis.original: संपत्ती अथवा विपत्ती । जैसी पडेल काळगती । नामस्मरणाची स्थिती । सांडूंच नये ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कधी श्रीमंती असेल तर कधी विपत्तीचा काळ असेल नामस्मरण मात्र चालूच ठेवावे. विसरु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: There may be prosperity or poverty; whatever may be your condition still, this state, the remembrance of this `name' should never be let slip.

owis.original: वैभव सामर्थ्य आणी सत्ता । नाना पदार्थ चालतां । उत्कट भाग्यश्री भोगितां । नामस्मरण सांडूं नये ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठे वैभव मिळाले, वा सामर्थ्याने सत्ता लाभली अनेक वस्तु वाट्यास आल्या आणि भाग्याने निरनिराळे भोग प्राप्त झाले तरी नामस्मरण विसरु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This `name' is the glorious power of your non-dual Self; it is the power of existence. There may be the prevalence of the `many' objects or the enjoyment of the wealth of lakshmi (this `all' of `I am'), but still this `name' should never be left.

owis.original: आधीं आवदसा मग दसा । अथवा दसेउपरी आवदसा । प्रसंग असो भलतैसा । परंतु नाम सोडूं नये ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवनांत आधी वाईट परिस्थिती व नंतर सुस्थिती आली किंवा आधी सुस्थिती व नंतर वाईट स्थिती आली, प्रसंग चांगले वाईट कसेही आले तरी नाम विसरु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: There may be a wretched condition followed by happy condition or a happy con- dition followed by a wretched one; there may be this sagun connection or whatever pleases you, but you should not leave this `name' of God.

owis.original: नामे संकटे नासती । नामें विघ्नें निवारती । नामस्मरणें पाविजेती । उत्तम पदें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाम घेत राहील्याने संकटे नाहीशी होतात. सर्व विघ्नांचे निवारण होते. नामस्मरणाने उत्तम गति किंवा पदे लाभतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this `name', calamities are destroyed; due to this `name' difficulties are avoided (when only this thought, `I am' is there then, thoughts and worries cannot remain) and by the remembrance of this `name' there will be the achievement of that highest state of nirgun brahman.

owis.original: भूत पिशाच्य नाना छंद । ब्रह्मगिर्‍हो ब्राह्मणसमंध । मंत्रचळ नाना खेद । नामानिष्ठें नासती ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाम निष्ठेने, श्रद्धेने घेतले तर भूतपिशाच्चांची पीडा नष्ट होते. कपटांपासून रक्षण होते. ब्रह्मराक्षससाचा त्रास असेल तर नाहीसा होतो. मुंजाची बाधा होत नाही. मंत्र जपण्यांत चूक झाल्याने लागलेले वेड नाहीसे होते.
owis.englishMeaning: These `many' longing have come because you have been possessed by the ele- ments (ie. you objectify) and the spirit of a brahmin (you long to gain more and more knowledge). These and the troubles caused by the `many' mantras are all destroyed by this `name' (every word is a mantra, every word has a power; `Please bring me tea' and look, tea arrives).

owis.original: नामें विषबाधा हरती । नामें चेडे चेटकें नासती । नामें होये उत्तम गती । अंतःकाळीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नामामुळे विषबाधा नाहीशी होते. नामामुळे चेटुक, जादुटोणा यांचा त्रास नाहीसा होतो. नामस्मरण करत राहील्याने अंतःकाळी उत्तम गति मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: The sufferings from poison (taking the objects of this world as true) are defeated by this `name' and by this `name' sorcery (imagination) is destroyed. Due to this `name', the highest state is achieved, at the end of time (at the end of this `all').

owis.original: बाळपणीं तारुण्यकाळीं । कठिण काळीं वृधाप्यकाळीं । सर्वकाळीं अंतःकाळीं । नामस्मरण असावें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लहानपणी, तरुणपणी, कठीण प्रसंगी, वृधपणी, सर्वकाळी व अंतःकाळी नामस्मरण करीत असावे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `name' is remembered in infancy (ie. an infant does not conceptualise and see difference) and this `name' should be remembered in youthfulness; it should be remembered in the gross and objective times, in old age, at the time of this `all' and at the end of time too.

owis.original: नामाचा महिमा जाणे शंकर । जना उपदेसी विश्र्वेश्र्वर । वाराणसी मुक्तिक्षेत्र । रामनामेंकरुनी ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नामाचे महत्व व मोठेपण स्वतः भगवान श्रीशंकर जाणतात. तो विश्र्वेश्र्वर लोकांना नामस्मरण करा असा उपदेश करतो. काशींत देह ठेवणारास श्रीशंकर रामनाम सांगतात व त्याला रामनामाने मुक्ति मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: Lord shankar knows the greatness of this `name' and at His temple in kashi (maharaj- the body is kashi), He teaches it to His mind. By taking this `name' of ram, the body becomes this temple of God (`all') and at this place, Final Liberation can be achieved. (It is said that if one dies in kashi then one will not take another birth. It means, if one dies while in this body ie. to leave the body concept then, one is set free to pervade everywhere).

owis.original: उफराट्या नामासाठीं । वाल्मिक तरला उठाउठी । भविष्य वदला शतकोटी । चरित्र रघुनाथाचें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रामनाम उलटे घेऊनही वाल्याचा वाल्मीकी ऋषी झाला व त्याने भविष्यांत होणारे श्रीरामाचे शतकोटी श्लोकांचे चरित्र श्रीरामाच्या जन्मा आधीच लिहून ठेवले.
owis.englishMeaning: valmiki was liberated by even taking this `name' of ram in reverse (He said mara instead of rama; the mantra is not important, it is the conviction). He is said to have told the life of ram before ram had even been born and he showed hundreds of ways to know Him (you are ram and the ramayan is your story and valmiki explained the means of your liberation; in this way, he told the story before ram was born in you).

owis.original: हरिनामें प्रल्हाद तरला । नाना आघातापासून सुटला । नारायेणनामें पावन जाला । अजामेळ ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हरिनाम घेऊन नाना संकटांतुन प्रल्हाद वाचला व त्याचा उद्धार झाला. नारायण नावाचा जप करुन अजामेळ पवित्र झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: By this `name' of hari, pralhad the great devotee of God was saved and the distress of the `many' was broken. And ajamela, a great sinner, was purified by this `name' of God.

owis.original: नामें पाषाण तरले । असंख्यात भक्त उद्धरले । महा पापी तेचि जाले । परम पवित्र ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नामा मुळे दगड तरंगले व प्रसिद्ध सेतु निर्माण झाला. अनेक भक्तांचा उद्धार झाला. अतिशय पापी लोकांनीसुद्धा नामाचा जप करुन स्वतःल पावन,पवित्र करुन घेतले.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this `name' the *stones were made to float and the devotee is lifted out of the `many'/mind. Due to this `name' of God, that Reality that was a great sinner, becomes the pure Supreme. *(This body is dead like a stone without this life principle `I am'. But making this thought `I am', the `many' thoughts recede and life remains)

owis.original: परमेश्र्वराचीं अनंत नामें । स्मरतां तरिजे नित्यनेमें । नामस्मरण करितां येमें । बाधिजेना ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमेश्र्वराची पुष्कळ नामे आहेत. नित्य नियमाने त्यांचे स्मरण केले तर मनुष्य तरुन जातो. नामस्मरण करणाराला यम यातना होत नाहीत. परमेश्र्वराच्या अनंत नामांपैकी कोठचेही नाम घेतले तरी भगवंत त्याचा उद्धार करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this `name' there is the endlessness of parameshwara and by continually repeating this `name', you will be saved and yama, the god of death, can give no punishment.

owis.original: सहस्रा नामामधें कोणी येक । म्हणतां होतसे सार्थक । नाम स्मरतां पुण्यश्र्लोक । होईजे स्वयें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताच्या असंख्य नामांपैकी कोणतेही एक नाम मनापासून जपत जावे. त्यामुळे मनुष्य जन्माचे सार्थक होणारच. नामाचे स्मरण करीत राहील्याने मनुष्य मोठा पुण्यात्मा होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the saying of these one thousand names (ie. all our worldly talk) there is that One within this `all' and to achieve Him is the fulfilment of your life. When you remember this `name' then, naturally you will become pure like Him.

owis.original: कांहींच न करुनि प्राणी । रामनाम जपे वाणी । तेणें संतुष्ट चक्रपाणी । भक्तांलागीं सांभाळी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाने कांहींच केले नाही व वाणीने फक्त रामनाम जपले, तरी त्याने भगवंत संतुष्ट होतो. आणि भक्ताचा सांभाळ करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if this `all' has not been created in the prana, still you should continuous repeat this `name' of ram. By this `name', vishnu is pleased and watches over that devotee (vishnu is said to be the protector of this world and his nature is to know. When you forget everything then what remains is this effortless knowing or vishnu. At that time you have stopped living as a jiva and have become this `all'-pervading knowledge).

owis.original: नाम स्मरे निरंतर । तें जाणावें पुण्यशरीर । माहां दोषांचे गिरिवर । रामनामें नासती ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो रामनामाचा जप करतो त्याचे शरीर पुण्यवान माणसाचे म्हणुन जाणावे. मोठमोठ्या पापांचे डोंगर त्याने नष्ट होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The truth is, it is that which is `void of this inner space' (ie. parabrahman) that is remembering this `name'; it is that Reality that is knowing this `all' body and this mountain of great sin (this concept of a gross body) gets destroyed by this `name' of ram. (In truth, you are that parabrahman, there is only that Reality)

owis.original: अगाध महिमा न वचे वदला । नामें बहुत जन उद्धरला । हळहळापासून सुटला । प्रत्यक्ष चंद्रमौळी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नामाचा महिमा एवढा अपरंपार आहे, कीं तो सगळा सांगणे शक्य नाही. नामस्मरणाने पुष्कळ लोकांचा उद्धार झाला आहे. प्रत्यक्ष शंकर हळाहळ विषापासून वाचला.
owis.englishMeaning: The importance of this `name' is so great that it cannot be described (ie. it is beyond the reach of words). Due to this `name', the mind is lifted out of worldly thoughts and placed in this `all'. Due to this `name', shankar escaped the effect of halahala (ie. the anxiety and troubles of the world). (You are brahma, vishnu and shankar; you are ravana and ram.It is said that shankar held that poison in His throat ie. He did not let it enter any further inside)

owis.original: बहुं वर्णां नामाधिकार । नामीं नाहीं लाहानथोर । जड मूढ पैलपार । पावती नामें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोठच्याही वर्णाचा माणुस नाम घेऊ शकतो. लहान मोठा कोणीही नाम घेऊ शकतो. अडाणी व मूर्ख माणसेसुद्धा नामस्मरणाने संसारांतुन उद्धरुन जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: All the four castes (ie. four bodies) have the right to speak God's `name'. Within this `name' there is no great or small and the gross and dull are liberated due to the taking of this `name'.

owis.original: म्हणौन नाम अखंड स्मरावें । रुप मनीं आठवावें । तिसरी भक्ती स्वभावें । निरोपिली ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणुन नाम नेहमी घ्यावे व ते घेतांना मनांत भगवंताचे रुप स्मरत असावे. अशारीतीने तिसरी भक्ती सांगितली.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore that unbroken brahman should remember this `name'. And when this `I am' form is remembered in the mind then, the third devotion is being discoursed. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Padsevan Bhakti (Devotion through Service at the Feet)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां जालें निरुपण । नामस्मरणाचें लक्षण । आतां ऐका पादसेवन । चौथी भक्ती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या आधीच्या समासामध्ये नामस्मरणालक्षणांचे विवेचन सांगितले. आता पादसेचन भक्ती या चौथ्या प्रकाराचे श्रवण करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously there was the remembering of this `name'. Now, listen carefully and do `service at the feet of the guru'; this is the fourth devotion.

owis.original: पादसेवन तेंचि जाणावें । कायावाचामनोभावें । सद्गुरुचे पाय सेवावे । सद्गतिकारणें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सद्गती मिळण्यासाठी म्हणजे भगवत्प्राप्तीसाठी कायेनें. वाचेनें, आणी मनानें सद्गुरुची चरणसेवा करणे याला पादसेवनभक्ति म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: `Service at the feet of the guru' will be understood when, with body, speech and mind, you have full conviction in your guru's teaching. To attain that highest state of nirgun brahman, the guru's feet have to be served (ie. if you have complete faith in the guru's teaching then you will act accordingly and gain direct experience of `I am'). (siddharameshwar maharaj- when one experiences that which the sadguru has taught, then one's service is complete)5

owis.original: या नांव पादसेवन । सद्गुरुपदीं अनन्यपण । निरसावया जन्ममरण । यातायाती ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्मरणाची यातायात कायमची जावी म्हणून सद्गुरुचरणी अनन्य होणे याला पादसेवन भक्ती म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This `name' is `service at the feet of the guru' and when this is completely absorbed in sadguru's state, then the endless coming and going of births and deaths will be cast off.

owis.original: सद्गुरुकृपेविण कांहीं । भक्ततरणोपाव तों नाहीं । । याकारणें लवलाहीं । सद्गुरुपाय सेवावे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा संसारसागर तरुन जाण्यास सद्गुरुकृपेशिवाय कांहीं उपाय नाही. यासाठी वेळ न दवडता सद्गुरुचे पाय सेवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Without the *blessing of sadguru, this knowledge that saves you from this worldly existence cannot be achieved. Therefore by means of this `name', you should serve your Master's feet and gain immediate and direct experience of who you truly are. (maharaj- how much time does it take?...it takes no time when you understand. At this moment you are He) *(Do and see for yourself)

owis.original: सद्वस्तु दाखवी सद्गुरु । सकळ सारासारविचारु । परब्रह्माचा निर्धारु । अंतरीं बाणे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सद्गुरु हाच सद्वस्तु म्हणजेच परमेश्र्वराचे दर्शन घडवून देतो. सद्गुरु चांगले-वाईट, काय घ्यावे काय सोडावे हे समजावून सांगतो. त्याच्याकडून श्रवण केल्याने परमेश्र्वराचे निश्र्चित ज्ञान मनांत ठसते.
owis.englishMeaning: sadguru reveals that Supreme Self when on account of this thought `I am' there comes that understanding, I do not exist (ie. to be, without being anything). Then parabrahman, the constant support of this `I am', is accepted.

owis.original: जे वस्तु दृष्टीस दिसेना । आणी मनास तेहि भासेना । संगत्यागेंविण ये ना । अनुभवासी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमात्मवस्तु डोळ्यांनी देसत नाही. कारण मनाला ती भासत नाही. संगत्यागावाचून तिचा अनुभव येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' cannot see that Supreme Self within it. That Supreme Self cannot be imagined by the mind and therefore without total detachment from all attachments, this `I am' experience cannot be absorbed in that thoughtless Reality.

owis.original: अनुभव घेतां संगत्याग नसे । संगत्यागें अनुभव न दिसे । हें अनुभवियासीच भासे । येरां गयागोवी ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी अनुभव घेतो " ही वृत्ती किंवा जाणीव जोपर्यंत असते तोपर्यंत ज्ञाता व ज्ञेय यांच्या वेगळेपणामुळे संगत्याग नसतो. दृश नाहीसे झाले म्हणजेच ' मी ' ही जाणीव नष्ट झाली की परमात्मवस्तुचा अनुभव येतो. हे बोलणे स्वानुभवी पुरुषाला बरोबर कळेल. इतरांना नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if this `I am' experience is accepted still, this cannot be called the abandonment of your attachments. This `I am' is also an attachment and it is only when this is abandoned can that thoughtless swarup be understood. The rest will remain entangled with all their worldly attachments.

owis.original: संगत्याग आणी निवेदन । विदेहस्थि ती अलिप्तपण । सहजस्थिती उ्मनी विज्ञान । हे सप्तहि येकरुप ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संगत्याग, निवेदन म्हणजे मीपणा तो परमेश्र्वराला अर्पण करणे. विदेहस्थिती, अलिप्तपणा, सहजस्थिती, उन्मनी आणि विज्ञान या सातही अवस्था एकच आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: This letting go of attachment is called surrendering to the atma; it is the state beyond the body/videha and it is being `untouched'; it is called the natural state or `no-mind'/unmani and the dissolution of knowledge. That thoughtless Reality is these seven states and they are all One.

owis.original: याहिवेगळीं नामाभिधानें । समाधानाचीं संकेतवचनें । सकळ कांहीं पादसेवनें । उमजों लागें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मसाक्षात्काराला आणखी कांहीं नांवे आहेत. पण साक्षात्काराने मिळणारे समाधान वर्णन करणारे ते भिन्न भिन्न शब्द समजावेत. पण हे सगळे सद्गुरुची चरणसेवा केल्यावर आपोआप कळूं लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if you remain attached to this `name' then, you will not gain the contentment of that thoughtless Self. Still, this divine `name' is the means of your reaching that Self and to understood this, there should be service at the your Master's feet.

owis.original: वेद वेदगर्भ वेदांत । सिद्ध सिद्धभावगर्भ सिद्धांत । अनुभव अनिर्वाच्य धादांत । सत्य वस्तु ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेदांचा अर्थ, वेदांचे रहस्य, वेदान्त तत्वज्ञान, शैव, सिद्धांचा मार्ग, सिद्धांच्या स्वानुभवाचे रहस्य, नाद बिंदु शुन्यता, अलक्षीं लक्ष, इत्यादि त्यांचे सिद्धांत, भगवंताच्या मार्गांतील विविध अनुभव, शब्दांच्या पलिकडे असणार्‍या गोष्टी, प्रत्यक्ष असले तरी भ्रम वाटणारे अनुभव, परमात्म वस्तु,
owis.englishMeaning: The essence of the vedas is vedanta (ie. the end of knowing). And vedanta is the understanding of the Master and it is called siddhanta (ie. Absolute Truth). There even this experience `I am' cannot be described and this is called Self-experience (dhadanta). That is the Supreme Self.

owis.original: बहुधा अनुभवाचीं आंगें । सकळ कळती संतसंगें । चौथे भक्तीचे प्रसंगें । गोप्य तें प्रगटे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी पारमार्थिक अनुभवाची अनेक अंगे आहेत. संतांची संगत लाभली तर ती सर्व कळतात. पादसेवन भक्तीच्यामुळे अशा गुप्त व गूढ गोष्टी उघडपणे स्पष्ट होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: First your mind should experience this `all' and then, this `all' should understand that Reality by staying in the company of the Truth/satsang. This fourth devotion is your connection to the `all' and by this, that hidden Self will be realised.

owis.original: प्रगट वसोनि नसे । गोप्य असोनि भासे । भासाअभासाहून अनारिसे । गुरुगम्य मार्ग ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमात्म वस्तु प्रगट असून नसल्यासारखी आहे. ती गुप्त असून मनाला भासते. परंतु ती वस्तु भास व अभास याहून निराळी आहे. तिला गुरुकडूनच शिकता येते. म्हणजे तीचे ज्ञान गुरुकडूनच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: This manifest `all' is and yet it is not; that purush is hidden and yet He has appeared as this `all'. That which is different from this perceptible/imperceptible (ie. prakruti emphpurush) is the way revealed by the guru (when all duality is left behind and you experience yourself directly, then neither `is' nor `is not' are valid terms to describe that One thoughtless Self).

owis.original: मार्ग होये परी अंतरिक्ष । जेथें सर्वहि पूर्वपक्ष । पाहों जातां अलक्ष । लक्षवेना ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पूर्वपक्षामध्ये स्वस्वरुपाबद्दल शंका किंवा आक्षेप घेतला जातो. सिद्धांतामध्ये त्याचे निरसन करुन स्वरुपसिद्धि केलेली असते. म्हणुन समर्थ सांगतात की आंत पाहतांना जें जें ज्ञेयपणानें ज्ञात होईल तें तें अनात्म्याच्या राज्यांत जाते. आत्मवस्तु तशी पाहाता येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The path of knowledge *(prakruti emphpurush) is said to be like the sky. For when you understand, nothing is there then, all that remains, is `you'. But this you is only supposition and if you want to understand that which is `inconceivable' then, you have to stop trying to concentrate on it. *(Witnessed and Witness; the beginning and end of duality, where the perceptible is being perceived by the imperceptible Self)

owis.original: लक्षें जयासी लक्षावें । ध्यानें जयासी ध्यावें । तें गे तेंचि आपण व्हावें । त्रिविध प्रचिती ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जी वस्तु लक्ष देऊन आंतमध्ये पहावी, ध्यानांमध्ये पहावी ती वस्तुच आपण होऊन जावे आणि शास्त्रप्रचिती, गुरुप्रचिती यंचा आत्मप्रचितीशी मेळ घालावा.आत्मवस्तु पाहातांना वेगळेपणाने उरतां कामा नये. तद्रूप होऊनच ती पाहावी लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is to be any attention then, this `I am' should be attended to; and if there is to an object of meditation then, this `I am' should be meditated upon. But then, that Reality is not and there is this `you' in that triad of Knower, known and knowing.

owis.original: असो हीं अनुभवाचीं द्वारें । कळतीं सारासारविचारें । सत्संगेंकरुन सत्योत्तरें । प्रत्ययासि येती ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. स्वस्वरुपाचा अनुभव घेण्याचे हे असे मार्ग आहेत. सारासार विचर केला म्हणजे ते कळतात. वर ज्या गोष्टी सांगितल्या आहेत त्या खरोखर सत्पुरुषाच्या संगतीस राहिल्यास अनुभवास येतील.
owis.englishMeaning: That understanding, I do not exist, is gained through this experience, `Only I exist.' By the company of the Truth/Saint and this *pure reply, `nothing is true,' that essence will be attained. *(maharaj- reply to the mind in such a way that the mind goes off)

owis.original: सत्य पाहातां नाहीं असत्य । असत्य पाहातां नाहीं सत्य । सत्याअसत्याचें कृत्य । पाहाणारापासीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सत्य असलेली परमात्म्य वस्तु तिच्याशी तद्रुप होऊन पाहिली, अनुभविली कीं असत्य असलेले दृश्य विश्र्व खरेपणाने उरत नाही आणि दृश्यच जोपर्यंत खरे वाटते तोपर्यंत परमात्म्याचा अनुभव येत नाही. म्हणुन अनुभव घेणार्‍याच्या आंतरिक अवस्थेवर सत्य व असत्य याची प्रचिती अवलंबून असते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the Truth is understood then, the false disappears. When the false is under- stood, then the Truth disappears. This dilemma between Truth and untruth remains as long as an `understander' is there. (True and false are the concepts of a Knower)

owis.original: पाहाणार पाहाणें जया लागलें । तें तद्रूपत्वें प्राप्त जालें । तरी मग जाणावें बाणलें । समाधान ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाहणारा कोणी परमात्मा पाहायला लागतो. परंतु तो त्याच्याशी तद्रूप झाला तरच परमात्मा पाहाता येतो. या तद्रूपेने अंगी समाधान बाणते.
owis.englishMeaning: The seer, by seeing establishes the seen and then that Reality appears as this form (ie. the nirgun becomes sagun). Nevertheless by this seeing, the complete contentment of no-seeing can be understood.

owis.original: नाना समाधानें पाहातां । बाणतीं सद्गुरु करितां । सद्गुरुविण सर्वथा । सन्मार्ग नसे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळी समाधानाने सद्गुरुची सेवा केल्याने आपल्या अंगी बाणतात. म्हणून सद्गुरु व त्याच्या सेवेशिवाय भगवंताकडे नेणारा दुसरा मार्ग नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When due to sadguru you understand the nature of the `many' thoughts then, complete contentment/samadhan is imbibed. But without sadguru this true way can never be attained.

owis.original: प्रयोग साधनें सायास । नाना साक्षेपें विद्याअभ्यास । अभ्यासें कांहीं गुरुगम्यास । पाविजेत नाहीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना प्रयोग करणे, नाना साधनांचा अभ्यास करणे, नाना सायास करणे, विद्या अभ्यास करणे यांनी परमात्म्याचे ज्ञान होत नाही. गुरुसेवेने जे मिळते ते या गोष्टींनी मिळत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: By sadhanas the `many' knowledges can be attained and by earnest study even this `all' can be attained but, the guru cannot be attained like this.

owis.original: जें अभ्यासें अभ्यासितां न ये । जें साधनें असाध्य होये । तें हें सद्गुरुविण काये । उमजों जाणें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो परमात्मा अभ्यास केल्याने अगर साधनांनी साध्य होत नाही. तो सद्गुरुसेवेनेच उमजु लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `all' is to be studied/practiced then, in truth, there should be no study/practice (ie. understand that, `I do nothing' is the greatest worship). Now if this `all' is unachievable by trying to achieve it then, tell me, how can that thoughtless Reality ever be understood, without sadguru?

owis.original: याकारणें ज्ञानमार्ग । कळाया धरावा सत्संग । सत्संगेविण प्रसंग । बोलोंचि नये ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून परमात्म्याच्या ज्ञानासाठी सत्संग धरावा त्याशिवाय परमात्म्याच्या अनुभवाचा विषय बोलू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Understanding this `I am' is walking on the path of knowledge and if you want to understand that Reality then, this path of knowledge should never be left. For tell me, how could this `I am' be spoken without the company of that Truth/Saint? (Understand that even this perceptible `I am' is an appearance illuminated by the light of that imperceptible thoughtless Reality)

owis.original: सेवावे सद्गुरुचे चरण । या नांव पादसेवन । चौथे भक्तीचें लक्षण । ते हे निरोपिलें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सद्गुरुच्या चरणांची सेवा करणे याचे नांव पादसेवन, असे हे चौथ्या भक्तीचें लक्षण सांगितले.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be this `I am' experience at the feet of the guru. Understanding His `name' is doing His service. And when your attention is placed on this fourth devotion then, there can be that thoughtless discourse by the guru.

owis.original: देव ब्राह्मण माहानुभाव । सत्पात्र भजनाचें ठाव । ऐसिये ठांई सद्भाव । दृढ धरावा ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, ब्राह्मण, ब्रह्मज्ञानी संत, सात्विक सज्जन हे सेवा करण्यास योग्य आहेत. अशांबद्दल सद्भाव मनांत ठेवावा व त्यांच्या संगतींत राहावे.
owis.englishMeaning: He is God, the brahmin (Knower of brahman) and the greatest experience (Self- experience). His place is the real receptacle of this fourth bhajan. Therefore this pure understanding should be firmly maintained.

owis.original: हें प्रवृत्तीचें बोलणें । बोलिलें रक्षाया कारणें । परंतु सद्गुरुपाय सेवणें । या नाव पादसेवन ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें आहे व्यावहारिक बोलणे. परंतु खरे तर सद्गुरु चरणांची सेवा करणे हेच पादसेवन होय.
owis.englishMeaning: This `speech' has become worldly and therefore it has to be once again protected. And then this `name' that serves His feet has to become sadguru's thoughtless state.

owis.original: पादसेवन चौथी भक्ती । पावन करितसे त्रिजगती । जयेकरितां सायोज्यमुक्ती । साधकास होये ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही चौथी भक्ती त्रैलोक्याला पावन करणारी आहे. ती आचरणांत आणली असतां साधकास सायुज्यमुक्ती मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the devotee serves the Master's feet then, he becomes the purest in the three worlds. On account of this `I am', that sadhak attains Final Liberation.

owis.original: म्हणौनि थोराहूनि थोर । चौथे भक्तीचा निर्धार । जयेकरितां पैलपार । बहुत प्राणी पावती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून ही चौथी भक्ती श्रेष्ठांत श्रेष्ठ भक्ति आहे. असा निश्र्चित निर्णय मी करितो. या भक्तीनें पुष्कळ लोक संसारसागराच्या पैलतीरास पोहोचतात. इति श्रीदाबोधे गुरुशिष्यसंवादे पादसेवनभक्तिनिरुपणनाम समास चवथा ॥
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore truly this fourth devotion is the `greatest of the great'. For on account of this `I am', this `all' that is caught in the prana, reaches the other side. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां जालें निरुपण । चौथे भक्तीचें लक्षण । आतां ऐका सावधान । पांचवी भक्ती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील समासांत चवथ्या भक्तीचे लक्षण सांगितले. आतां सावधान होऊन पांचव्या भक्तीचे लक्षण ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously we had a discourse on the fourth devotion. Now, be alert and listen and there will be the fifth devotion.

owis.original: पांचवी भक्ति तें आर्चन । आर्चन म्हणिजे देवतार्चन । शास्त्रोक्त पूजांवेधान । केलें पाहिजे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पांचवी भक्ती म्हणजे अर्चन म्हणजेच देवतांची शास्त्रोक्त पूजा करणे हे होय. आणी तशी पूजा केली पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: This fifth devotion is called worship and it means that all the gods and all the rules regarding them, that have been laid down by the scriptures, should be left aside/com- pletely destroyed.6

owis.original: नाना आसनें उपकर्णें । वस्त्रें आळंकार भूषणें । मानसपूजा मूर्तिध्यानें । या नाव पांचवी भक्ती ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना आसनें, पूजेची उपकरणे, वस्त्रे, अलंकार, भूषणें आदि वापरु देवांची पूजा करावी. तसेच देवाच्या मूर्तीचे ध्यान करुन मानसपूजा करावी. या पूजेला पांचवी भक्ती म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' asanas/postures and means and apparatus; there are the `many' forms of coverings and appearances; there are the `many' elaborate arrangements and embellishments, virtues and accomplishments. But if this image of God is meditated upon (ie. forget everything and knowledge is there), then this worldly mind will get dissolved within this knowledge `I am'. This is called the fifth devotion and this is worship.

owis.original: देवब्राह्मणअग्निपूजन । साधुसंतअतीतपूजन । यतिमाहानुभावगाइत्रीपूजन । या नाव पांचवी भक्ती ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, ब्राह्मण, अग्नि, साधुसंत, अतिथि संन्यासी, महात्मा, गाय यांची पूजा करावी. त्याला पांचवी भक्ती म्हटले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this puja (dissolution of every concept) of God, brahmin and fire; this puja of the sadhu, Saint and the uninvited guest; this puja of the ascetic, the `great experienced' and the gayatri mantra, then there is this `I am' and this is the fifth devotion (ie. nothing is there).

owis.original: धातुपाषाणमृत्तिकापूजन । चित्रलेपसत्पात्रपूजन । आपलें गृहीचें देवतार्चन । या नाव पांचवी भक्ती ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सोनें, चांदी, तांबें  आदी धातुंच्या देवतांच्या मूर्ति, दगडी व मातीच्या मूर्ति, चित्रें, तसबिरी आणी उत्तम भांडी यांची पूजा करावी. तसेच घरांतील देवांची पूजा करावी. याला पांचवी भक्ती हे नांव आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This puja (by the utter destruction of every concept) of the images made of metal, stone and clay; of the pictures or paintings of those worthy of honour; is the worship of that God who is hidden within us and this is the fifth devotion.

owis.original: सीळा सप्तांकित नवांकित । शालिग्राम शकलें चक्रांकित। लिंगें सूर्यकांत सोमकांत । बाण तांदळे नर्बदे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सात व नऊ शुभचिन्हें असलेले दगड, शाळिग्राम, चक्राचे चिन्ह असलेले दगडाचे तुकडे, पिंडी, उन्हांत धरल्यावर ज्यांतून अग्नि बाहेर पडतो असे सूर्यकांत मणी, चांदण्यांत ज्यांतून पाझर बाहेर पडतो असे चंद्रकांत मणी, बाण, शेंदूर लावलेले दगड, नर्मदेंतील गोटे,
owis.englishMeaning: This puja/dissolution of the various symbols, among them particular stones with seven or nine markings, stones called shaligrams, small coral figures with circular shapes, lingas, stones called suryakant, chandrakant, bana, tandalay and stones found in the river narmada is the proper worship of God.

owis.original: भैरव भगवती मल्लारी । मुंज्या नृसिंह बनशंकरी । नाग नाणी नानापरी । पंचायेत्नपूजा ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भैरव, भगवती, मल्लारी, मुंज्या, नृसिंह, बनशंकरी, नाग, अनेक प्रकारची नाणीं, पंचायतनें,
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' is the puja/dissolution of the gods bhairav, bhaigavati, malhari, munjya, nrusinha, banashankari; it is the puja/dissolution of the `many' things that people worship, like the symbol of the cobra and coins and it is the puja of panchayatana (vishnu, sun, ganapati, goddess and shiva all together).

owis.original: गणेशशारदाविठ्ठलमूर्ती । रंगनाथजगंनाथतांडवमूर्ती । श्रीरंगगनुमंतगरुडमूर्ती । देवतार्चनीं पूजाव्या ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गणेश, शारदा, विठ्ठल, रंगनाथ, जगन्नाथ, नटराज, श्रीरंग, हनुमंत, गरुड,
owis.englishMeaning: This image `I am' is the worship of ganesh, sharada, vitthal, ranganath, jagannath, the dancing shiva, shrirang, hanumanta and garuda is puja.

owis.original: मत्छकूर्मवर्‍हावमूर्ती । नृसिंहवामनभार्गवमूर्ती । रामकृष्णहयग्रीवमूर्ती । देवतार्चनीं पूजाव्या ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मत्स्य, कूर्म, वराह, नृसिंह, वामन, परशुराम, राम, कृष्ण, हयग्रीव, अशा सर्वांच्या मूर्तिची पूजा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: This image `I am' is the worship of the incarnations of vishnu; matsya, koorma and varaha (the fish, tortoise and boar incarnations); this image `I am' is nrusinha, vamana and bhargava; it is ram, krishna and hayagreeva; this is puja and it is the worship of God. (These are the ten incarnations of vishnu)

owis.original: केशवनारायणमाधवमूर्ती । गोविंदविष्णुमदसुदनमूर्ती । त्रिविक्रमवामनश्रीधरमूर्ती । रुषीकेश पद्मनाभि ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: केशव, नारायण, माधव, गोविंद, विष्णु, मधुसूदन, त्रिविक्रम, वामन, श्रीधर, हृषिकेश, पद्मनाभ,
owis.englishMeaning: This image `I am' is the puja of keshav, narayana, madhav, govind, vishnu, mad- husudana, trivikrama, vaman, shridhar, hrishikesh and padmanabh.

owis.original: दामोदरसंकर्षणवासुदेवमूर्ती । प्रद्युम्न अनुरधपुरुषोत्तममूर्ती । अधोक्षजनारसिंहअच्युतमूर्ती । जनार्दन आणि उपेंद्र ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दामोदर, संकर्षण, वासुदेव, प्रद्युम्न, अनिरुद्ध, पुरुषोत्तम, अधोक्षज, नरसिंह, अच्युत, जनार्दन, उपेंद्र,
owis.englishMeaning: This image `I am' is the puja of damodara, sankarshana, vasudev, pradyumna, aniruddha, purushottama, adhokshaja, narasinha, achyut, janardana and upendra.

owis.original: हरिहरांच्या अनंत मूर्ती । भगवंत जगदात्माजगदीशमूर्ती । शिवशक्तीच्या बहुधा मूर्ती । देवतार्चनीं पूजाव्या ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याप्रमाणें हरिहरांच्या अनंत मूर्ति, भगवंत, जगदात्मा, जगदीश, यांच्या मूर्ति, आणि शिवशक्तीच्या अनेक मूर्ति घेऊन त्यांची पूजा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' is the worship of that endless harihara (forget everything/hara/shankar and He is there/hari/vishnu); it is the worship of bhagvanta, the atma and Lord of the world. When the `many' images are this image of shiva-shakti then, this is puja and the worship of God.

owis.original: अश्र्वत्थनारायेण सूर्यनारायेण । लक्ष्मीनारायेण त्रिमल्लनारायेण । श्रीहरीनारायण आदिनारायण । शेषशाई परमात्मा ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें अश्वत्थनारायण, सूर्यनारायण, लक्ष्मीनारायण, त्रिमल्लनारायण, श्रीहरिनारायण, आदिनारायण, शेषशायी परमात्मा,
owis.englishMeaning: This image `I am' is the puja of ashwathhla-narayana, surya-narayana, laxmi- narayana, trimalla-narayana, shrihari-narayana, adi-narayana, sheshadhayi and pa- ramatma.

owis.original: ऐश्या परमेश्र्वराच्या मूर्ती । पाहों जातां उदंड असती । त्यांचे आर्चन करावें भक्ती । पांचवी ऐसी ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा परमेश्र्वराच्या अगणित मूर्ति आहेत. त्यांचे पूजन करावे. ही पाचवी भक्ती होय.
owis.englishMeaning: When you try to understand that vast Supreme Self then, there is this image `I am' of that Self. Such is called the worship of the atma and this is the fifth devotion.

owis.original: याहि वेगळे कुळधर्म । सोडूं नये अनुक्रम । उत्तम अथवा मध्यम । करीत जावें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याशिवाय आपल्या घराण्यांतील कुलधर्म असतील ते जसे चालत असतील तसेच करावेत. ते उत्तम वा मध्यम जसे असतील तसे करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' image is separate from the family deities and ritual worship. First leave these rituals and understand this sagun `I am' and then leave this also and be that nirgun Self. Only the highest (nirgun) or middle (sagun) forms of worship should be performed and the lowest, these rituals, should be given up.

owis.original: जाखमाता मायराणी । बाळा बगुळा मानविणी । पूजा मांगिणी जोगिणी । कुळधर्में करावीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाखमाता, मायराणी, बाळा, बगुळा, मानविणी, मांगिणी, जोगिणी, या क्षुद्र देवतांची व स्त्रियांची पूजा जर कुळधर्मांत असेल तर ती सुद्धा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: They are called jakhamata, mayarani, bala, bagula and manavini; the puja/destruction of these and mangini, jogini and all the other family deities should be made.

owis.original: नाना तीर्थां क्षेत्रांस जावें । तेथें त्या देवाचें पूजन करावें । नाना उपचारीं आर्चावें । परमेश्र्वरासी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या तीर्थक्षेत्रांत जावें, तेथील देवांची पूजा करावी. अनेकप्रकारच्या साधन सामग्रीने परमेश्र्वराची पूजा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: You should make the puja of the gods at the `many' places of pilgrimage that you have visited. Your `many' efforts and means should all be offered to that Supreme Self.

owis.original: पंचामृतें गंधाक्षतें । पुष्पें परिमळद्रव्यें बहुतें । धूपदीप असंख्यातें । नीरांजनें कर्पुरार्ती ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचामृत, गंधाक्षता, फुलें, अत्तरादि, पुष्कळ सुगंधी द्रव्यें, धूपदीप, नाना प्रकारच्या आरत्या व निरांजने,
owis.englishMeaning: The panchamrut ritual performed with paste of sandalwood, coloured rice, flowers, rich perfumes, ghee and wicks is due to this `all'. And this `all' is due to that immeasu- rable paramatma. Even the camphor that provides the flame for the arati is because of that niranjan (ie. that Self illuminated paramatma; everything whether good or bad, virtuous or sinful, all take place within this `all' and it is illuminated by that Self).

owis.original: नाना खाद्य नैवेद्य सुंदर । नाना फळें तांबोलप्रकार । दक्षणा नाना आळंकार । दिव्यांबरें वनमाळा ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेगवेगळ्या प्रकारचे खाण्याचे नैवेद्य, निरनिराळी फळे, तांदूळ, दक्षणा, अलंकार, भारी वस्त्रें, वनमाला,
owis.englishMeaning: There are `many' beautiful eatables offered in worship; there are `many' different kinds of fruit and pan leaves and gifts given to the brahmin priests; there are the `many' elaborate decorations, clothes and garlands of flowers.

owis.original: सिबिका छत्रें सुखसनें । माहि मेघडंब्रे सूर्यापानें । दिंड्या पताका निशाणें । टाळ घोळ मृदांग ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पालख्या, छत्रें, आरामशीर आसने, छत्र्या, पालखीच्या छत्र्या, अबदागिर्‍या, दिंड्या, पताका, निशाणें, टाळ, मृदंग, घोळ,
owis.englishMeaning: In the `many' there are umbrellas, seats, canopies, totems with an image of the sun, flags on poles, banners, cymbals, drums and tabor.

owis.original: नाना वाद्यें नाना उत्साव । नाना भक्तसमुदाव । गाती हरिदास सद्भाव । लागला भगवंतीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक वाद्यें, अनेक प्रकारचे उत्सव, त्यांत जमा होणारे भक्तजन, आणि तेथें हरिदास भगवंताचे गुणगान करुं लागले म्हणजे भगवंताबद्दल श्रद्धा निर्माण होते.
owis.englishMeaning: In the `many' there are the musical instruments and in the `many' there are the great celebrations. These `many' things become this meeting place of the `all' when you are devoted to hari and sing His song (leaving aside the `many' names and forms, you understand knowledge and sing the song of God, `I only am'). Then you are staying in God.

owis.original: वापी कूप सतोवरें । नाना देवळायें सिखरें । राजांगणें मनोहरें । वृंदावनें भुयारीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाण्याचे आड, विहिरी, तळीं, नाना प्रकारची देवळें व त्यांची शिखरें, मोठी आंगणें, सुंदर वृंदावने, तळघरें,
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' wells, ponds and reservoirs and there is this temple of knowledge with its spire of vignyan (ie. every creature in this world is a small receptacle for this `living water' or `I am' or knowledge, consciousness, chaitanya etc., it has so many names. And every creature exists within this knowledge. And this knowledge is the manifestation of that imperceptible Self). There is the captivating courtyard (ie. knowledge) with the *vrundavan and there is a hidden chamber (I do not exist) within this temple of `I am'. *(A small structure ie. body, containing the holy tulsi maharaj-tulsi means to dissolve yourself)

owis.original: मठ मंड्या धर्मशाळा । देवद्वारीं पडशाळा । नाना उपकर्णें नक्षत्रमाळा । नाना वस्त्र सामग्री ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मठ, दुकानांच्या जागा, धर्मशाळा, देवाच्या दाराशी ओसर्‍या, इतर अनेक साधने, रंगीत कागदी फुलांच्या माला, अनेक प्रकारची वस्त्रें,
owis.englishMeaning: There is this place of worship with its canopy of clouds above (ie. this gross existence) and there is that temple of dharma (knowledge; to be and to know, is your inherent nature/dharma). And within this temple of God there is the resting place of the pilgrim, I do not exist. Otherwise there are the `many' means of worship and the `many' articles of worship and the `many' clothes and materials for worship.

owis.original: नाना पडदे मंडप चांदोवे । नानारत्नघोष लोंबती बरवे । नाना देवळाईं समर्पावे । हस्थि घोडे शक्कटें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेगवेगळे पडदे, मंड्या, छतें, मोत्यांचे लोंबणारेघोस, हत्ती, घोडे, रथ व गाड्या निरनिराळ्या देवळांना अर्पण करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this covering of knowledge there are the `many' coverings and veils and celebration halls; due to this beautiful `all' there are the `many' attractive clusters of jewels and pearls. The `many' elephants and horses that are offered to the `many' temples should be offered to this temple of God. (Stop seeing with the eyes of your intellect and see with the eyes of knowledge; do not think it is very beautiful; say it is "So,so")

owis.original: आळंकार आणी आळंकारपात्रें । द्रव्य आणी द्रव्यपात्रें । अन्नोदक आणी अन्नोदकपात्रें । नाना प्रकारीची ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अलंकार व ते ठेवण्याच्या पेट्या, द्रव्य व ते ठेवण्याच्या पेट्या, अन्नोदक व ताटें, वाट्या, पातली, हंडे, व इतर भांडी,
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' decorations and there is the worthy recipient of these deco- rations. There are the `many' manifestations and there is the worthy recipient of these manifestations. There is this `food and water' (this `I am' is the food and water of life) and there is the worthy recipient of this `food and water'. There are the `many' forms and there is this `I am' form within; which will you choose? (God/purush is the worthy recipient of all)

owis.original: वनें उपवनें पुष्पवाटिका । तापस्यांच्या पर्णकुटिका । ऐसी पूजा जगन्नायका । येथासांग समर्पावी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जंगलें, बागा, फुलवाड्या, तापसी साधकांसाठी झोपड्या, अशा प्रकारचे उपचार अर्पण करुन जगन्नाथ ईश्र्वराची पूजा होते. आपण ते उपचार त्याला मनापासून अर्पण करावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: There are forests, orchards and flower gardens and the dwelling places of the ones doing penance. These should all be completely offered to that `Lord of the world'. (ie. nothing is true)

owis.original: शुकशारिका मयोरें । बदकें चक्रवाकें चकोरें । कोकिळा चितळें सामरें । देवाळईं समर्पावी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पोपट, साळुंख्या, मोर, बदकें, चक्रवाक, चकोर, कोकिळा, हे पक्षी आणी चितळ, सांबर या प्रकारची हरणें, देवालयांत अर्पण करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: The parrots, sarika, peacocks, ducks, chakrawak, chakor, cuckoos, antelopes and elks should all be offered in this temple. (Destroy or offer up all these names and forms and see with the eyes of knowledge)

owis.original: सुगंधमृगें आणी मार्जरें । गाई म्हैसी वृषभ वानरें । नाना पदार्थ आणी लेंकुरें । देवाळईं समर्पावी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें कस्तुरी मृग, मांजरें, गाई, म्हशी, बैल, वानरें, हीं जनावरें, अणखी नाना प्रकारचे पदार्थ व लहान मुलें देवालयांना अर्पण करावीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The kasturi deers, cats, cows, buffaloes, bulls and monkeys; the `many' objects and your own children, should all be offered in this temple of `I am'.

owis.original: काया वाचा आणी मनें । चित्तें वित्तें जीवें प्राणें । सद्भावें भगवंत आर्चनें । या नांव आर्चनभक्ती ॥ २९ ॥
