owis.marathiMeaning: काया, वाचा, मन, चित्त, वित्त, जीव व प्राण हीं सगळीं भगवंताच्या पायीं अर्पण करुन अगदी मनापासून त्याची पूजा करणें यास अर्चनभक्ति म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Your body and speech should be offered by the mind; your thinking, the known, the jiva and the prana should all be offered. When God is worshipped with the under- standing, `nothing is there' then, `I am' is revealed and this is called worship and it is the fifth devotion.

owis.original: ऐसेचि सद्गुरुचें भजन । करुन असावें अनन्य । या नाव भगवद्भजन । पांचवी भक्ती ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशाच रीतीनें श्रीसद्गुरुची पूजा करुन त्याच्याशी अनन्य शरणागत होणें, ही भगवंताची पूजा समजावी. यालाच पांचवी भक्ती म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Such worship becomes the bhajan of sadguru when it is performed with no sense of otherness. This `I am' is the bhajan of God and this is the fifth devotion (ie. otherness remains).

owis.original: ऐसी पूजा न घडे बरवी । तरी मानसपूजा करावी । मानसपूजा अगत्य व्हावी । परमेश्र्वरासी ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाहेरील उपचार वापरुन अशी पूजा घडूं शकत नाही. ती मनाने अंतर्यामी करावी. मानसपूजा करणे अगत्याचे आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Such puja has not been properly made unless there is the puja of the mind. For this, the mind should be completely offered to that Supreme Self.

owis.original: मनें भगवंतास पूजावें । कल्पून सर्व हि समर्पावें । मानसपूजेचें जाणावें । लक्षण ऐसें ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनाने अंतर्यामी भगवंताची पूजा करुन त्याला सर्व अर्पावे. हा मानसपूजा विधी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Your mind should make this puja. When your imagination and even this `all' are offered to God then, this is the puja of the mind.

owis.original: जें जें आपणास पाहिजे । तें तें कल्पून वाहिजे । येणें प्रकारें कीजे । मानसपूजा ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जे जे आपणास हवे ते ते कल्पना करुन देवास द्यावे. हे मानसपूजेंत करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When you want something then, that Reality begins to imagine this `I am' (though you need nothing for there is One without another). But if you want nothing at all then, you do not exist and that is the puja of the mind. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां जालें निरुपण । पांचवे भक्तीचे लक्षण । आतां ऐका सावधान । साहावी भक्ती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील समासांत पांचवी भक्तीचे निरुपण झाले. आतां सहावी भक्ती मन लावून ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously this fifth devotion was discoursed. Now, listen alertly and there will be the sixth devotion.

owis.original: साहावी भक्ती तें वंदन । करावें देवासी नमन । संत साधु आणी सज्जन । नमस्कारीत जावे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नमस्कार करणें ही सहावी भक्ती. देवाला नमस्कार करावा. संत, साधु व सज्जन यांना नमस्कार करीत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is to be this sixth devotion, then one should bow down to God with utmost respect. The Saint, sadhu and sajjana should be honoured by this namaskar/bowing down.

owis.original: सूर्यासि करावे नमस्कार । देवासि करावे नमस्कार । सद्गुरुस करावे नमस्कार । साष्टांग भावें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्याला नमस्कार घालावा. देवाला नमस्कार घालावा. सद्गुरुला मनापासून साष्टांग नमस्कार घालावा.
owis.englishMeaning: This namaskar should be made to the sun (ie. the one who reveals the world of `many' names and forms); this namaskar should be made to God (purush). And this namaskar should be made to sadguru through complete surrender (sastang namaskar- lit. to bow down with all eight bodies; I do not exist).

owis.original: साष्टांग नमस्कारास अधिकारु । नाना प्रतिमा देव गुरु । अन्यत्र नमनाचा विचारु । अधिकारें करावा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साष्टांग नमस्कार करण्यास अनेक प्रकारच्या देवाच्या प्रतिमा, भगवंत आणी सद्गुरु हे योग्य अधिकारी आहेत. इतरांना त्यांच्या योग्यतेप्रमाणे नमस्कार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' images of God, there is the one who has the authority to make this sastang namaskar and there is God and guru. (ie. the one who has the authority to make this sastang namaskar, I do not exist, is the one who has understood this `I am') When this `I am' has been understood then, the one who has this authority should surrender this `I' and be that thoughtless Self (that thoughtless understanding is the surrender of this eighth body `I am'. Then only God or guru remains).

owis.original: छपन्न कोटी वसुमती । मधें विष्णुमूर्ती असती । तयांस नमस्कार प्रीती । साष्टांग घालावे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या पृथ्वीचा व्यास छपन्न कोटी आहे. त्यामध्यें अनेक विष्णुमूर्ति आहेत. त्या सर्वांना साष्टांग नमस्कार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: To know that within each of the *fifty-six classes of creatures on this earth there is this `all' of vishnu is called bowing down. This is real love and then that sastang namaskar should be made (leaving aside the `many' thoughts of this world, see this `all' with the eyes of knowledge. Then you will see yourself everywhere and this is love.7 Now this `I' should also be left aside). *(25 subtle and 25 gross elemental divisions of the body, 4 forms of birth, ignorance and knowledge)

owis.original: पशुपति श्रीपति आणी गभस्ती । यांच्या दर्शनें दोष जाती । तैसाचि नमावा मारुती । नित्य नेमें विशेष ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शंकर, विष्णु व सूर्य यांच्या दर्शनाने पापें नाहीशी होतात. त्यांना व मारुतीला विशेष करुन नित्यनेमाने नमस्कार घालावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Understand this `I am'; it is the vision of pushupati (shiva, as the lord of all creatures ie. every living creature is myself), it is the vision of shripati (vishnu; all creation is myself) and it is the vision of the sun (My light reveals this gross world of names and form). This vision removes the sin of body consciousness. Thus, forget everything, every moment and with this pure sattwa guna, humble bow down before maruti, the Lord of the prana/breath (when thoughts of this world are left off then, this world and the sense of being this body cannot remain; then there is the `seeing'/vision of this `I am' and your beingness expands to pervade all that is perceived. The natural rising and falling of the breath/prana appears as a mere part within this whole moving `I am' form or chaitanya. With this understanding, the Lord of all this, is being bowed down to)

owis.original: भक्त ज्ञानी आणी वीतरागी । माहानुभाव तापसी योगी । सत्पात्रें देखोनि वेगीं । नमस्कार घालावे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्त, ज्ञानी, वैरागी, स्वानुभवी, तापसी, योगी आणि श्रेष्ठ व्यक्ति यांना बघितल्यावर लगेच नमस्कार घालावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The devotee is the gnyani, desireless yogi, ascetic and great-`experienced' when this knower of the `all' sincerely makes this sastang namaskar.

owis.original: वेदज्ञ शास्त्रज्ञ आणी सर्वज्ञ । पंडित पुराणिक आणी विद्वजन । याज्ञिक वैदिक पवित्रजन । नमस्कारीत जावे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेद जाणणारे, शास्त्रज्ञ, सर्व विद्या जाणणारे, पंडित, पुराणिक, विद्वान, आणी पवित्र व्यक्ति या सर्वांना नमस्कार घालावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The knower of the shasthras, the Knower of the `all', the pandit who explains the puranas, the philosophers, the performers of fire sacrifices, doctors and good people should all be honoured by the making of this namaskar (when one sees everyone with the equal vision).

owis.original: जेथें दिसती विशेष गुण । तें सद्गुरुचें अधिष्ठान । या कारणें तयासी नमन । अत्यादरें करावें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या व्यक्तिमध्ये विशेष गुण दिसतील ती व्यक्ति सद्गुरु योग्यतेची मानून आदराने त्यांस नमस्कार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: First these `many' forms that were being seen through the sense organs should be seen with this `vision' of knowledge and then that place of sadguru should be understood. By means of this `I am' (ie. effortless knowing or bowing down) there should be the bowing down to that Reality (ie. sastang namaskar; surrender of this knowledge).

owis.original: गणेश शारदा नाना शक्ती । हरिहरांच्या अवतारमूर्ती । नाना देव सांगों किती । पृथकाकारें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गणेश, शारदा, निरनिराळ्या शक्ति देवता, हरिहरांच्या अवतारमूर्ति, निरनिराळे देव किती सांगावे सर्वांना नमस्कार करीत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: But ganesh (purush) and sharada (prakruti) have become the `many' powers; and this incarnation `I am' of *harihara has become the `many' gods and that thoughtless understanding of God has become the `many' separate forms. *(Forgetting is remem- bering; when all is made to zero then, effortless knowing remains)

owis.original: सर्व देवांस नमस्कारिलें । तें एका भगवंतास पावलें । येदर्थीं येक वचन बोलिलें । आहे तें ऐका ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व देवांस नमस्कार करावा. तो एक भगवान विष्णुनाच पोहोचतो. याबद्दल एक वचन सांगितले आहे ते ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: However when prakruti bows down to Her purush then, she attains that One God. Therefore listen because, in truth, it is that One God who is speaking this divine `word' (understand that the purush or God is the One speaking this `I am' and when there is listening, understand it is that God who is the listener; therefore why should `you' come in between?).

owis.original: या कारणें सर्व देवांसी । नमस्करवें अत्यादरेंसीं । अधिष्ठान मानितां देवांसी । परम सौख्य वाटे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या कारणाने सर्व देवांना अति आदराने नमस्कार करावेत. सर्व देवांमध्ये भगवंताचे वास्तव्य आहे अशी भावना ठेवली तर भगवंताला मोाठा आनंद होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: By means of this `speech', this `all' should bow down to God/purush with the utmost respect (this `all' knowledge should, of its own accord, dissolve in that beyond knowledge). When you honour this original place of God then, that supreme content- ment will be felt (this `speech' of the `all' should be surrendered; after-all it is God who is the speaker and listener of this `I am' and the understanding, I do not exist).

owis.original: देव देवांचीं अधिष्ठाने सत्पात्रें सद्गुरुचीं स्थानें । या कारणें नमस्कार करणें । उभय मार्गीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळ्या देवांमध्ये भगवंताचे चास्तव्य आहे. सर्व साधु-संत-सज्जन यांचे ठिकाणी श्रीसद्गुरुचे वास्तव्य आहे ही भावना ठेवून दोघांना नमस्कार करावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: If this original place of that God of the gods is honoured then, that worthy recipient will attain the place of the sadguru (I do not exist). Therefore by means of this `speech' (namaskar) and that thoughtless understanding (sastang namaskar; surrender of the eighth body), the God of the gods and sadguru are bowed down to (by that thoughtless understanding the purush is attained. But this may slip away once more. However when this thought `I am' is forever absorbed in that thoughtless Self, like the salt in the ocean, then that place of sadguru, that will never spoil, is attained).

owis.original: नमस्कारें लीनता घडे । नमस्कारें विकल्प मोडे । नमस्कारें सख्य घडे । नाना सत्पात्रासीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नमस्कारानें नम्रता येते. तसेच अहंकार कमी होत असल्याने विकल्प कमी होतो. अनेक सज्जनांशी स्नेह निर्माण होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this namaskar, one becomes humble. Due to this namaskar, the thoughts are removed. Due to this namaskar, a friendship develops between the `many' objects and this ocean of knowledge.

owis.original: नमस्कारें दोष जाती । नमस्कारें अन्याय क्ष्मतीं । नमस्कारें मोडलीं जडतीं । समाधानें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नमस्कारानें अंगांतील दोष जातात. नमस्काराने माणुस चुकलेला असेल तर त्याला क्षमा मिळते. परत स्नेह जडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this namaskar, the sin (ie. to forget your Self) is destroyed and the fault of being a body is forgiven. Due to this namaskar, the broken contentment becomes unbroken.

owis.original: सिसापरता नाहीं दंड । ऐसें बोलती उदंड । याकारणें अखंड । देव भक्त वंदावें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाचें डोके उडविणे ही मोठी शिक्षा आहे. असे पुष्कळ लोक म्हणतात. म्हणुन देवांना व भक्तांना डोके झुकवून नमस्कार घालावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Beyond the limitations of your mind there is no wilfulness and there is that vast Supreme Self/paramatma speaking this `I am'. Therefore the devotee should worship that unbroken God by means of this `speech' (all this is the play of that One Supreme Self. He is the limited mind and He is you the devotee worshipping Himself and He is One without another also)

owis.original: नमस्कारें कृपा उचंबळे । नमस्कारें प्रसन्नता प्रबळे । नमस्कारें गुरुदेव वोळे । साधकांवरी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नमस्काराने ज्याला नमस्कार केला त्याची कृपा लाभते. तो प्रसन्न होतो. सद्गुरु साधकाकडे लवकर येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this namaskar, grace overflows. Due to this namakar, there is joy in abun- dance. Due to this namaskar, guru-dev turns towards the sadhak.

owis.original: निशेष करितां नमस्कार । नासती दोषांचे गिरिवर । आणी मुख्य परमेश्र्वर । कृपा करी ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदीं मनापासून कोणताही विकल्प मनांत न ठेवता भगवंताला नमस्कार केला तर पापाचे डोंगर नष्ट होतात. आणि परमेश्र्वराची कृपा संपादन होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When one makes a full unreserved namaskar then, this mountain of sin is destroyed. Then that Supreme Self/parameshwara bestows His grace.

owis.original: नमस्कारें पतित पावन । नमस्कारें संतांसी शरण । नमस्कारें जन्ममरण । दुरी दुर्‍हावे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नमस्काराने भ्रष्ट माणसें पवित्र होतत. नमस्कार करुन संताना शरण जाता येते. नमस्काराने जन्म-मरणापासून मुक्ती मिळू शकते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this namaskar, the sinner becomes pure; due to this namaskar to that eternal Saint, birth and death are left far aside.

owis.original: परम अन्याय करुनि आला । आणी साष्टांग नमस्कार घातला । तरी तो अन्याये क्ष्मा केला । पाहिजे श्रेष्ठीं ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा माणूस फार गुन्हेगार असला व त्याने साष्टांग नमस्कार घातला तर श्रेष्ठींनी अधिकारी व्यक्तींनी क्षमा केली पाहीजे.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that Supreme Self who has committed this mistake and become manifest (ie. the mistake was to become something ie. to be/`I am') but if He makes that *sastang namaskar then, in that thoughtless Self this offence will be forgiven. *(Surrenders this eighth body of `I am')

owis.original: या कारणें नमस्कारापरतें । आणीक नाहीं अनुसरतें । नमस्कारें प्राणीयातें ॥ सद्बुद्धि लागे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या कारणानें आचरणांत आणण्यास नमस्कारासारखे दुसरे सोपे साधन नाही. नमस्कार केल्याने अंगात सद्बुद्धि निर्माण होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Other than this namaskar nothing more is required. Due to this namaskar, the one in the prana acquires a pure intellect/buddhi.

owis.original: नमस्कारास वेचावें नलगे । नमस्कारास कष्टावें नलगे । नमस्कारास कांहींच नलगे । उपकरण सामग्री ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नमस्कार करण्यासाठी कांही खर्च येत नाही. कांही कष्ट करावे लागत नाहीत. किंवा कांही इतर साधन सामुग्री लागत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: This namaskar requires no expenditure. This namaskar causes no distress or fatigue (otherwise there is the distress and fatigue of being a body). To make this namaskar this `all' does not need suitable utensils and materials (only to forget everything).

owis.original: नमस्कारा ऐसें नाहीं सोपे । नमस्कार करावा अनन्यरुपें । नाना साधनीं साक्षपें । कासया सिणावें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नमस्काराइतकें सोपे साधन नाहीपण नमस्कार अत्यंत मनापासून करावा. अधिक साधने वापरुन उगाच कष्ट का करावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: However such a namaskar is not easy, for such a namaskar has to be made with the feeling of no-otherness. Why though, should one take all the trouble of the `many' sadhanas that are merely obstructions?

owis.original: साधक भावें नमस्कार घाली । त्याची चिंता साधूस लागली । सुगम पंथे नेऊन घाली । जेथील तेथें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो साधक अत्यंत श्रद्धेने व भावाने नमस्कार साधुस करतो, त्याची काळजी साधु घेतो. तो साधु त्या माणसाला सोप्या मार्गाने भगवंताकडे पोहोचवितो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the sadhak makes this namaskar with understanding then, his mind me- ets that sadhu and He leads him on the easy path to that brahman within this maya. (siddharameshwar maharaj- you should make the guru's intellect/buddhi, your intellect/buddhi.)

owis.original: या कारणें नमस्कार श्रेष्ठ । नमस्कारें वोळती वरिष्ठ । येथें सांगितली पष्ट । साहावी भक्ती ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यामुळे नमस्कार करणे हे मोठे साधन आहे. नमस्कार केल्याने भगवंत व सद्गुरु नमस्कार करणार्‍याकडे खेचले जातात. अशारीतीने सहावी भक्ति स्पष्टपणे सांगितली.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this speech `I am' there is that most excellent sastang namaskar (I do not exist). By this namaskar that Supreme turns to face you and then this sixth devotion becomes that pure thoughtless Self. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Dasya Bhakti (Devotion through Service as a Servant)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागा जालें निरुपण । साहावे भक्तीचे लक्षण । आतां ऐका सावधान । सातवी भक्ती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील समासांत सहाव्या भक्तीचें वर्णन झाले. आतां सातवी भक्ती लक्ष देऊन ऐकावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously the sixth devotion was discoursed; now, listen alertly and there will be this seventh type of devotion.

owis.original: सातवें भजन तें दास्य जाणावें । पडिले कार्य तितुकें करावें । सदा सन्निधचि असावें । देवद्वारीं ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचें दास्य करणें म्हणजे सातवी भक्ति होय. देवाच्या दाराशी त्याची सेवा करण्यासाठी असणे, देवाचे जे काम असेल ते आपण करणे.
owis.englishMeaning: This seventh bhajan should be known as the `careful preservation' of your understan- ding. When every action is dropped (ie. " I am doing this and that") then, there is this `all' action (ie. `He is doing'). In this way you should always remain near the door of God (forget everything and carefully preserve the understanding of `I am' or `He is').

owis.original: देवाचें वैभव सांभाळावें । न्यूनपूर्ण पडोंचि नेदावें । चढतें वाढतें वाढवावें । भजन देवाचें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाच्या वैभवाचे रक्षण करणे, ते कमी होऊं न देणे,  ते वाढेल तसे वाढवणे व वाढवण्याचा प्रयत्न करणे.
owis.englishMeaning: One should carefully protect God's glory (this `all'); one should not allow any defi- ciency in regards to this. This `all' understanding should be made to expand, for this is the bhajan of God (in every action, `I am or He is there'). (maharaj- be so big you pervade the whole creation).

owis.original: भंगलीं देवालयें करावीं । मोडली सरोवरें बांधावीं । सोफे धर्मशाळा चालवावीं । नूतन चि कार्यें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भंगलेली देवालयें दुरुस्त करावी. मोडलेले तलाव, पाण्याचे साठे दुरुस्त करावे. सोपे, धर्मशाळा बांधाव्या. मोडल्या असतील तर त्यांचे नूतनीकरण करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: This temple of `I am' has become dilapidated due to neglect and it should be re- paired. The leaking reservoir should be shored up (this has not been properly cared for; siddharameshwar maharaj- the reservoir is the mind and the leaks are the scatte- red thoughts). This resting place of the pilgrim should be reconstructed or made anew (ie. this `I am'; the mind should be made to understand that, whatever is seen and perceived is not true).

owis.original: नाना रचना जीर्ण जर्जर । त्यांचे करावें जीर्णोद्धार । पडिलें कार्य तें सत्वर । चालवित जावें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जुन्या मोडकळीसआलेल्या धर्मशाळा वगैरे बांधकामांचा जीर्णोद्धार करावा. देवाचे जे जे कार्य असेल ते ते लगोलग करीत जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' old and tormented constructions are to be replaced with new ones (the old concepts should be replaced with proper vivek). And whatever is required to be done should be done with the utmost earnestness.

owis.original: गज रथ तुरंग सिंहासनें । चौकिया सिबिका सुखासनें । मंचक डोल्हारे विमानें । नूतन चि करावीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हत्ती, रथ, घोडे, सिंहासनें, चौरंग, पालख्या, सुखासने, पलंग, डोलारे, विमानें वगैरे सर्व नविन करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Elephants, horses and chariots are there, on account of this throne of the King (ie. knowledge or `all'); royal seats and reclining couches are there, on account of place where God comfortable rests; palankins and chairs are there, on account of this knowledge `I am'; therefore only this `ever new' should be formed (there are the the `many' places for the kings to sit and there is this one place where the King ie. atma, should stay. This `I am' should be constructed at every place).

owis.original: मेघडंब्रें छत्रें चामरें । सूर्यापानें निशाणें अपारें । नित्य नूतन अत्यादरें । सांभाळित जावीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मेघडंबर्‍या, छत्रें, चारें, अबदागिर्‍या, पुष्कळ निशाणें, या वस्तु साफ करुन निट जतन कराव्या.
owis.englishMeaning: Understand that it is due to that limitless Supreme Self/paramatma that there is so much paraphernalia like canopies, umbrellas, ceremonial fans, insignias and flags. The- refore, with great love this `ever new moment' should be carefully protected (everything is `now' and everywhere `I am' there; this whole creation is the grandeur of my form).

owis.original: नाना प्रकारीचीं यानें । बैसावयाचीं उत्तम स्थानें । बहुविध सुवर्णासनें । येत्ने करीत जावीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचीं नाना प्रकारची वाहनें,  बसावयासाठी उत्तमोत्तम जागा, निरनिराळी सोन्याची आसनें, वगैरे प्रयत्नपूर्वक करावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: By means of this `speech', the `many' different ways should be placed upon that most high place. By making this great effort, the ways of the `many' should attain His `golden seat' (ie. Reality). (maharaj- everything is that Reality; mind is that Reality)

owis.original: भुवनें कोठड्या पेट्या मांदुसा । रांझण कोहळीं घागरी बहुवसा । संपूर्ण द्रव्यांश ऐसा । अति येत्नें करावा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घरें, खोल्या, पेट्या, पेटारे, रांजण, पाण्यासाठी मोठी भांडी, पुष्कळ घागरी, अशा किमती वस्तु देवासाठी द्याव्या.
owis.englishMeaning: There are `many' boxes, jars, baskets, trunks, pots, utensils and storerooms (ie. the many forms in which this knowledge exists). With very great effort these parts should be gathered together in one place (the `many' forms should be made this `all').

owis.original: भुयेरीं तळघरें आणी विवरें । नाना स्थळें गुप्त द्वारें । अनर्घ्ये वस्तूंची भांडारें । येत्नें करीत जावीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक ठिकाणी भुयारे, तळघरे, बोगदे करावेत. त्यांना गुप्त दारे ठेवावीत. मौल्यवान वस्तु ठेवण्यासाठी कोठारे प्रयत्नपूर्वक करावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: You should build store-rooms, tunnels and basements in this temple (you should think deeply and see that which others cannot see). The `many' chambers should have a secret door (this door is hidden to most and the key is understanding) and in the treasury below this temple that priceless Self should be preserved through great effort.

owis.original: आळंकार भूषणें दिव्यांबरें । नाना रत्नें मनोहरें । नाना धातु सुवर्णपात्रें । येत्नें करीत जावीं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवासाठी, त्याच्या उत्सवासाठी दागिने, भूषणें, उंची वस्त्रे, सुंदर रत्नें, अनेक धातुंची व सोन्याची भांडी मोठ्या प्रयत्नाने मिळवावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: This knowledge should be embellished with beautiful clothes and ornaments (the sky is my clothes and sun, moon and stars and clouds are my ornaments). The `many' thoughts should acquire these jewels by the conquering of the mind (these jewels are these nine bhajans, this `word' and that thoughtless understanding). Through great effort, the `many' *dhatus are to be placed within this golden receptacle of knowledge. *(Elemental substances of the body and this gross creation)

owis.original: पुष्पवाटिका नाना वनें । नाना तरुवरांचीं बनें । पावतीं करावीं जीवनें । तया वृक्षांसी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फुलबागा, रानें, झाडांच्या राया, तयार कराव्या, त्यांना पाणीवगैरे देऊन त्यांची निगा राखावी.
owis.englishMeaning: There are gardens of `many' flowers (ie. sensory experiences) and *forests of `many' trees (ie. bodies). But if you become less objective by leaving off the thoughts of this world then, that gross objective body will become that thoughtless Self. (siddharame- shwar maharaj- this body is a walking, talking tree... without this `I am' you cannot live for even a moment) *(maharaj- ram was lost in the forest, this objective world, and he asked the trees and the stones, "Have you seen my sita?" Means, he was asking the objects of the world, "Please give me some happiness")

owis.original: नाना पशूंचिया शाळा । नाना पक्षी चित्रशाळा । नाना वाद्यें नाट्यशाळा । गुणी गायक बहुसाल ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या जनावरांसाठी, तबेले, निरनिराळे पक्षी, अनेक चित्रांचा संग्रह, अनेक वाद्ये, नाटकशाळा व रंगभूमी, पुष्कळ चांगले गायक,
owis.englishMeaning: The mind is the place of `many' beasts and the mind is the place of `many' colourful birds; the mind is the place of `many' learnings and the place of singing and dancing for `many' years.

owis.original: स्वयंपाकगृहें भोजनशाळा । सामग्रीगृहें धर्मशाळा । निद्रिस्तांकारणें पडशाळा । विशाळ स्थळें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वयंपाकघरे, जेवण्यासाठी पाकशाळा, स्वयंपाकाचे सामान ठेवण्यासाठी कोठ्या, झोपण्यासाठी कोठ्या, सर्व कोठ्या मोठ्या ठेवाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: This mind is this place for cooking and the place of eating. This body is having everything required for actions and it is the place of your dharma also (in this body you can know yourself). And when you sleep it is your place of rest and then it becomes vast (ie. when you go to sleep, this world goes off. But if you sleep to this world by dropping your thoughts of a world then, the limitations of being a body disappear and you become vast).

owis.original: नाना परिमळद्रव्यांचीं स्थळें । नाना खाद्यफळांचीं स्थळें । नाना रसांची नाना स्थळें । येत्नें करीत जावीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारच्या सुवासिक वस्तु ठेवण्यासाठी जागा, निरनिराळ्या प्रकारचे खाण्याचे पदार्थ व फळे ठेवण्यासाठी जागा, पातळ पदार्थ ठेवण्यासाठी जागा, प्रयत्नपूर्वक बनवाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' places where the scents of substances are experienced and the `many' places where the fruits of past actions are experienced. There are the experiences of `many' tastes and the `many' sentiments. But by great effort that One should be established in all of these.

owis.original: नाना वस्तांचीं नाना स्थानें । भंगलीं करावीं नूतनें । देवाचें वैभव वचनें । किती म्हणौनि बोलावें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या वस्तु ठेवण्याच्या जागा जर जुन्या झाल्या असतील अगर मोडकळीस आल्या असतील तर नविन कराव्या, देवाचे वैभव वर्णन करुन सांगावे तेवढे थोडेच.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' has been broken into so `many' things and so `many' places and should be made anew. Therefore your mind should speak this `word' and tell of the glory of God.

owis.original: सर्वां ठाईं अति सादर । आणी दास्यत्वास हि तत्पर । कार्यभागाचा विसर । पडणार नाहीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाकडे येणार्‍या सर्व भक्तांविषयी आदर बाळगावा. त्यांची व भगवंताची सेवा करण्यास तत्पर असावे. आपल्या वाट्याचे काम लगेच करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When you are very alert at this place of `I am' and completely absorbed in its `careful preservation' then, there will never be any forgetting of this `all' action (this `all' is one moving action or chaitanya; it is understood when you give up the `many' actions of "I am doing this and that etc.").

owis.original: जयंत्या पर्वें मोहोत्साव । असंभ्याव्य चालवी वैभव । जें देखतां स्वर्गींचे देव । तटस्थ होती ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाच्या जयंत्या, पर्वे मोठ्या वैभवाने करावेत की जे पाहून स्वर्गांतील देवसुद्धा थक्क होतील.
owis.englishMeaning: This is the place where God takes His incarnation (ie. knowledge); and this is the time of overflowing abundance and joy (ananda). This is the glory that cannot be imagined and by this vision of `I am' the gods of heaven are spellbound (these gods are the gunas and the various deities said to rule over the sense organs etc).

owis.original: ऐसे वैभव चालवावें । आणी नीच दास्यत्वहि करावें । पडिले प्रसंगी सावध असावें । सर्वकाळ ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचे वैभव वाढवत ठेवावे. तसेच हलक्यांतील हलकी देवाची सेवा करण्यासही तत्पर नेहमी तयार असावे.
owis.englishMeaning: His glory should be made to shine and then lovingly preserved. If you remain alert then, no matter what appears upon this `I am', still there is this time of the `all' (ie. `now').

owis.original: जें जें कांहीं पाहिजे । तें तें तत्काळचि देजे । अत्यंत आवडीं कीजे । सकळ सेवा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवासाठी जें  जें आवश्यक असेल तें तें त्वरित द्यावे. अत्यंत आवडीने देवाची सर्व सेवा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `all' of mula maya is maintained then, at that time, that Reality will be given to you. Therefore you should with great fondness, experience and preserve this `all'.

owis.original: चरणक्षाळणें स्नानें आच्मनें । गंधाक्षतें वसनें भूषणें । आसनें जीवनें नाना सुमनें । धूप दीप नैवेद्य ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाचे पाय धुण्यासाठी, स्नानासाठी, आचमनासाठी पाणी ठेवावे. गंधक्षता, वस्त्रे, अलंकार, आसनें, निरनिराळी फुलें, धूप, दीप, नैवेद्य तयार ठेवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Then, when washing your feet, bathing, sipping the sacred water, dressing, adorning one's self, sitting, eating, offering flowers and food etc., always He is there.

owis.original: शयेनाकारणें उत्तम स्थळें । जळें ठेवावीं सुसीतळें । तांबोल गायनें रसाळें । रागरंगें करावीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाला निद्रा घेण्यासाठी चांगल्या खोल्या, पिण्यासाठी गार पाणी, विडा, रागदारीने रसाळ गायन गावे.
owis.englishMeaning: By sleeping to this world, that superior guna is acquired (ie. knowledge). Then all the smells, tastes, songs, joys and delights are this beautiful knowledge.

owis.original: परिमळद्रव्यें आणी फुलेलें । नाना सुगंधेल तेलें । खाद्य फळें बहुसालें । सन्निधचि असावीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सुगंधी पदार्थ, फुलांची तेले, निरनिराळी सुगंधी तेलें, पुष्कळ खाण्याचे पदार्थ, फळे, देवाच्या जवळच ठेवावीत व प्रसाद म्हणून लोकांना पण द्यावीत.
owis.englishMeaning: There are `many' rich fragrances, scented perfumes and `many' fragrant oils but this wonderful fruit of the `all', with its rind of the `many', should always be kept near-by (knowledge only knows; it is not bothered if the smell comes from a perfume or from a sewer. It is the mind that creates `many' likes and dislikes. Therefore leave the `many' thoughts and enjoy this knowledge that is free of concepts).

owis.original: सडे संमार्जनें करावीं । उदकपात्रें उदकें भरावीं । वसनें प्रक्षालून आणावीं । उत्तमोत्तमें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: झाडलोट करावी, सडा घालावा, रांगोळ्या काढाव्या, पाण्याच्या भंड्यांत स्वच्छ पाणी भरुन ठेवावे, देवाचे कपडे, वस्त्रे स्वच्छ धुवून ठेववीात.
owis.englishMeaning: Everywhere will be purified when you become less and less objective. All these coverings (ie. elements and concepts) should be washed away and then, that best of the best acquired.

owis.original: सकळां करावें पारपत्य । आलयाचें करावें आतित्य । ऐसी हे जाणावी सत्य । सातवी भक्ती ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाच्या दर्शनास येणार्‍या सर्वांचे आदरातिथ्य करावे. अशी ही सातवी भक्ती आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way this `all' should be preserved and everyone should be treated like guests (no attachment to family or friends; they have come and will go, but He is always there). This understanding, you should know, is the seventh devotion.

owis.original: वचनें बोलावीं करुणेचीं । नाना प्रकारें स्तुतीचीं । अतंरे निवती सकळांची । ऐसें वदावें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाच्या दासाचे बोलणे करुणेने भरलेले दयाद्र असावे, दुसर्‍याबद्दल व देवाबद्दल चांगले बोलावे की त्यामुळे सर्वांना समाधान वाटेल.
owis.englishMeaning: When this forgiving and compassionate divine `word' is spoken (let everything come and let everything go, it is all the same to me) then, the `many' ways will make His praise. By this `speech', your inner space will become calm and rest in the `all'.

owis.original: ऐसी हे सातवी भक्ती । निरोपिली येथामती । प्रत्यक्ष न घडे तरी चित्तीं । मानसपूजा करावी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी ही सातवी भक्ती माझ्या अल्पबुद्धिने वर्णन केली. प्रत्यक्षांत सर्व करता आली नाही तरी मानसपूजेंत करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless swarup is this seventh devotion then, still this discourse is taking place within the mind (even this `I am' is the mind and not that thoughtless no- mind). Therefore, when these sensory experiences do not appear in your chitta/thinking and this `all' is understood then, there should be the puja/dissolution of this mind (see

owis.original: ऐसें दास्य करावें देवाचें । येणेंचि प्रकारें सद्गुरुचें । प्रत्यक्ष न घडे तरी मानसपूजेचें । करित जावें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असे देवाचे व तसेच सद्गुरुचे दास्यत्व करावे. जरी प्रत्यक्ष करता आले नाही तरी मानसपूजेंत करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: If God is `carefully preserved' then, that thoughtless way of sadguru can be under- stood. When sensory experiences do not arise then, there will be this knowledge `I am' and afterwards there should be the dissolution of this mind (ie. beyond knowledge) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Sakhya Bhakti (Devotion through Friendship with God)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां जालें निरुपण । सातवें भक्तीचें लक्षण । आतां ऐका सावधान । आठवी भक्ती ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागील समासांत सातव्या भक्तीचे वर्णन झाले. आतां आठवी भक्ति नीट लक्षपूर्वक ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously this seventh devotion was discoursed. Now, listen with attention and there will be this eighth devotion.

owis.original: देवासी परम सख्य करावें । प्रेम प्रीतीनें बांधावें । आठवें भक्तीचें जाणावें । लक्षण ऐसें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाशी दृढ मैत्री करावी. प्रेम भावनेने देवाला जणु बांधुनच ठेवावे. हे आठव्या भक्तीचे लक्षण समजुन घ्यावे.
owis.englishMeaning: There should be friendship with that Supreme God (atma purush); you should be bound to Him with great love. Such should be known as the eighth devotion.

owis.original: देवास जयाची अत्यंत प्रीती । आपण वर्तावें तेणें रीतीं । येणें करितां भगवंतीं । सख्य घडे नेमस्त ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाला अतिशय आवडणार्‍या गोष्टी आपण कराव्यात. त्यामुळे भगवंताशी दाट मैत्री जडते.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' of mula maya has great love for God and if you exist as this `I am' then, a close friendship with God will ensue. (That `I am' is not God but it is near to God; He remains hidden within this knowledge and He can never be known;8 He can only be directly experienced by being Him).

owis.original: भक्ति भाव आणी भजन । निरुपण आणी कथाकीर्तन । प्रेमळ भक्तांचें गायन । आवडे देवा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्ति, प्रेमाचा भाव, भजन, निरुपण, कथा-किर्तन, प्रेम भावनेने गाणार्‍या भक्तांचे गायन देवाला आवडते.
owis.englishMeaning: God likes devotion, faith and bhajan; He likes this sagun discourse and the singing of kirtana (ie. to expand your pervasive); He likes the speaking of His `story' and this hymn, `I am He', that is sung by His loving devotees.

owis.original: आपण तैसेंचि वर्तावें । आपणासि तेंच आवडावें । मनासारिखें होतां स्वभावें । सख्य घडे नेमस्त ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण त्याप्रमाणे वागावे. देवाला जे आवडते ते आपल्यालाही आवडावे. देवाच्या मनाप्रमाणे झाले की मैत्री जडते.
owis.englishMeaning: When you exist in this way only, then that Reality has fondness for you. When your mind becomes like this `I am' then, naturally a firm friendship will develop (maharaj- mind is your best friend and your worst enemy).

owis.original: देवाच्या सख्यत्वाकारणें । आपलें सौख्य सोडून देणें । अनन्यभावें जीवें प्राणें । शरीर तेंहि वेंचावें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाच्या मैत्रीसाठी आपण आपले देहसौख्य सोडून द्यावे. आपला जीव, प्राण व शरीर देवाला अर्पून मी देवासाठी आहे असा भाव ठेवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: For the sake of God's friendship, you should let go of your happiness (do not seek happiness as a goal; happiness is a state of mind that comes and goes. maharaj- it's a sensation only). Due to the understanding of no-otherness (ie. there is One only; I do not exist), the jiva in the prana and even this `I am' body should not remain.

owis.original: सांडून आपली संसारवेथा । करित जावी देवाची चिंता । निरुपण कीर्तन कथा वार्ता । देवाच्याचि सांगाव्या ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या संसारांतील सुख-दुःख बाजूस ठेवून देवाच्या सुखाची कामाची काळजी घ्यावी. देवाच्या कथा, किर्तन, निरुपण व गोष्टी सांगाव्या.
owis.englishMeaning: Leaving off the worries of samsar, you should care only for God. Still even this discourse of God's `story' (sagun) is a rumour and it should become that nirgun.

owis.original: देवाच्या सख्यत्वासाठीं । पडाव्या जिवलगांसी तुटी । सर्व अर्पावें सेवटीं । प्राण तोहि वेचावा ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाच्या मैत्रीसाठी जीवलग मित्र व नातेवाईकांशी संबध तुटले तरी चालेल. सर्व देवाला अगदी प्राणसुद्धा अर्पावा.
owis.englishMeaning: For the sake of God's friendship, there will be estrangement from your beloved resting place (ie. `all'). Because in the end when that nirgun understanding comes, this `all' will have to be given up along with the prana and that Witness also.

owis.original: आपुलें आवघें चि जावें । परी देवासीं सख्य राहावें । ऐसी प्रीती जिवें भावें । भगवंतीं लागावी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपले सर्व गेले तरी चालेल पण भगवंताशी मैत्री तुटु देऊ नये. अशी मैत्री जीवाभावाने देवाशी व्हावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Everything that you has claimed was yours, should *disappear but that intimate friendship with God should remain. You should love God with all your life. *(maharaj- you feel that you are losing everything, but what you are gaining is so great)

owis.original: देव म्हणिजे आपुला प्राण । प्राणासी न करावें निर्वाण । परम प्रीतीचें लक्षण । तें हें ऐसें असें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव म्हणजे जणुकांही आपला प्राणच समजाव. देव आपल्याला प्राणाहून प्रिय असावा. दृढ मैत्रीचे लक्षण असे असते.
owis.englishMeaning: In the beginning, your prana should be called God and therefore your prana should not disappear (when the breath is there, everything is there; when the breath is not, nothing is there; maharaj- `when you awake, space is there. When space is there then, knowledge must be there. And then breathing comes': when you forget everything then your awareness expands and along with everything else there is the natural rising and falling of the breath). Pure love is when you give up your prana and then that thoughtless Reality meets Its own Self (pure love is, I do not exist).

owis.original: ऐसें परम सख्य धरितां । देवास लागे भक्ताची चिंता । पांडव लाखाजोहरीं जळतां । विवरद्वारें काढिले ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाशी अशी उत्कट मैत्री जोडली म्हणजे देवाला अशा भक्ताची काळजी लागते. पांडवांचा सख्य भाव एवढा उत्कट होता की लक्षाघरांत ते आगींत सापडले असतां भगवंताने त्यांना गुप्त गुहेंतून सुखरुप बाहेर काढले.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is such supreme friendship then, the chitta/thinking process of the devotee meets God. The pandavas escaped from the burning house of wax through this tunnel. (The pandavas are the 5 elements, the house of wax is the body and the tunnel is the breath. The mind is thinking many thoughts in rapid sequence and each thought confirms the conviction "I am a body." Now if these thoughts are relinquished then your field of awareness will expand and in this process the mind will relinquish this elemental body and start to imagine that this whole elemental world is its home)

owis.original: देव सख्यत्वें राहे आपणासी । तें तों वर्म आपणाचि पासीं । आपण वचनें बोलावीं जैसीं । तैसीं येती पडसादें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपले जितके शुद्ध प्रेम, मैत्री असते, तशीच देवही आपल्याशी मैत्री ठेवतो. आपण जसे  बोलतो तसेच प्रतिध्वनी आपल्याला ऐकावयास येतात. आपली श्रद्धा देवावर अनन्य भावाने असेल तर देवही आपली काळजी घेतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is such friendship then, God remains with you always and that essence is near by (ie. God only exists, I do not). When you speak this divine `word' then, its echo will be just the same (then everywhere resounds with the sound `I am').

owis.original: आपण असतां अनन्यभावें । देव तत्काळचि पावे । आपण त्रास घेतां जीवें । देवहि त्रासे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपला भाव जर अनन्य असेल तर व एका भगवंतावरच आपला विश्र्वास, श्रद्धा, निष्ठा असेल तर भगवंत आपल्याला तत्काळ प्रसन्न होतो. पण आपण त्याला कंटाळलो तर तोही आपल्याला कंटाळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And when you have the conviction of no-otherness then, at that time only, God is achieved. But if you accept the troubles of being a jiva, then God is also troubled.

owis.original: जैसें जयाचे भजन । तैसाचि देवहि आपण । म्हणौन हें आवघें जाण । आपणासि पासीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या भावनेने आपण भगवंताचे भजन करतो, त्याच भावनेने भगवंत आपल्यावर अनुग्रह करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: And if your bhajan is this `I am' then, God will also be this. Therefore know that to be that thoughtless swarup or a mind full of so many thoughts, lies in your hands only.

owis.original: आपुल्या मनासारिखें न घडे । तेणें गुणें निष्ठा मोडे । तरी गोष्टी आपणाकडे । सहजचि आली ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादी गोष्ट आपल्या मनासारखी झाली नाही तर त्यामुळे भगवंतावरील आपले प्रेम, निष्ठा, श्रद्धा कमी होते. तसेच भगवंताचेही आपल्यावरील प्रेम, ममत्व कमी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When you don't appear as your mind then, that strong attraction for the mixed gunas and objectification is broken. Then this `I am story' that is in your possession naturally appears (ie. for you are the Knower and speaker of this `story').

owis.original: मेघ चातकावरी वोळेना । तरी चातक पालटेना । चंद्र वेळेसि उगवेना । तर्‍ही चकोर अनन्य ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चातक मेघाचेच पाणी पितो. मेघाने वृष्टी केली नाही तर चातकाची तहान  शमत नाही. पण तो मेघावरील प्रेम कमी करत नाही. तसाच चकोर चंद्राला उगवायला उशीर झाला तरी तो चकोर तसाच भुकेलेला उपाशी राहतो. पण चंद्रावरील प्रेम कमी करत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If the cloud does not turn towards the chataka bird, still this bird will not go elsewhere for water. If the moon will not rise on time, still the chakor bird keeps undivided attention and will be waiting for the moon only.

owis.original: ऐसें असावें सख्यत्व । विवेकें धरावें सत्व । भगवंतावरी ममत्व । सांडूंचि नये ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सख्य, मैत्री अशी असावी. भगवंताची मैत्री मोठ्या विवेकाने धरुन ठेवावी. त्याच्याशी असलेले सख्य, मैत्री, प्रेम कमी होऊन देऊ नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Your friendship should be like this. Through vivek, this sattwa guna should be held firmly and in this way, your love for God should never be let slip.

owis.original: सखा मानावा भगवंत । माता पिता गण गोत । विद्या लक्ष्मी धन वित्त । सकळ परमात्मा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताला सखा मानावा. तोच माता, तोच पिता, तोच नातेवाईक व सगेसंबधीही तोच मानावा. तसेच विद्या, लक्ष्मी, धन व वित्तसुद्धा भगवंतच. आपले जे जे ते ते सर्व तो परमात्मा भगवंतच अशी भावना बाळगावी.
owis.englishMeaning: You should regard God as your closest friend, your mother, father, relatives, lear- ning, wealth and money; then one should regard God as this `all' and finally that Supreme Self/paramatma (maharaj- everything you see and perceive is not, still He is there).

owis.original: देवावेगळें कोणी नाहीं । ऐसें बोलती सर्वहि । परंतु त्याची निष्ठा कांहीं । तैसीच नसे ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याला देवाखेरीज कोणीच नाही. असे सर्वच म्हणतात. परंतु त्यांचा खरा भाव तसा नसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is nothing other than God and it is He who is speaking this `I am'. But if you should take Him to be this `all' then, He is not there (when you feel `I am' then, God has become this `I am everywhere'; but in truth, He is One. Therefore this act of witnessing has to be dropped. How can there be witnessing where there is no-otherness?)

owis.original: म्हणौनि ऐसें न करावें । सख्य तरी खरेंचि करावें । अंतरी सदृढ धरावें । परमेश्र्वरासी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणुन असे खोटे वागु नये. देवाशी सख्य, मैत्री खरी भावना ठेवूनच करावे. मनांत देवाबद्दल प्रेम दृढ धरुन ठेवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore one should not do like this and then that friendship will be true. *para- meshwara resides within this inner space of `I am' and He should be firmly established. *(ie. Supreme God or paramatma or parabrahman ie. beyond/para manifestation)

owis.original: आपुलिया मनोगताकारणें । देवावरी क्रोधास येणें । ऐसीं नव्हेत किं लक्षणें । सख्यभक्तीचीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या मनासारखी एखादी गोष्ट झाली नाही तर देवावर रागावणे, नाराज होणे हे खर्‍या सख्य भक्तीचे लक्षण नव्हे.
owis.englishMeaning: But if on account of your *`inner intent', anger arises then, God is covered over and then due to this attention, that friendship with God, is not. *(To be or to know; this feeling is the original separation and upon this there arises the feeling "I am a body" and desire, anger, fear etc.)

owis.original: देवाचें जें मनोगत। तेंचि आपुलें उचित । इच्छेसाठी भगवंत । अंतरुं नये कीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताच्या इच्छेने जे घडून येईल तेच आपल्यासाठी योग्य आहे. आपली इच्छापूर्ती करण्यासाठी भगवंत अशा भावनेने भगवंतास दुरावी नये.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this `inner intent' of God then, this `inner intent' to be, becomes your reward. And on account of this wish to be, how can there not be an intervening space created between you and God?

owis.original: देवाचे इच्छेनें वर्तावें । देव करील तें मानावें । मग सहजचि स्वभावें । कृपाळु देव ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाच्या इच्छीनेच आपले वर्तन असावे. देव करील ते स्वीकारावे. मग सहजच कृपाळु असलेला देव आपल्याला हवे ते देइल.
owis.englishMeaning: Still one should live with this wish of God and then whatever God does, this should be *respected. Then naturally this spontaneous `all' will receive God's blessing. *(Let whatever has to come, come; let whatever has to go, go)

owis.original: पाहातां देवाचे कृपेसी । मातेची कृपा कायेसी । माता वधी बाळकासी । विपत्तिकाळीं ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाची कृपा ही मातेच्या ममत्वापेक्षा मोठी असते. संकट ओढवले तर माता आपल्याच बाळाचा वध करते. देवाचे तसे नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If one understands this blessing of God then, what are the blessings of the mother (ie. maya)? The mother kills her child, in this time of misfortune (when one takes body consciousness).

owis.original: देवें भक्त कोण वधिला । कधीं देखिला ना ऐकिला । शरणागतांस देव जाला । वज्रपंजरु ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरण आलेल्याचा देव कधीच वध करत नाही उलट त्याचे रक्षणच करतो. त्याचा देवाने वध केला असे कधीच कोणी ऐकलेले नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Has God ever killed a devotee? This can never happen when one searches out and listens to this `I am'. God becomes the protecting armour of the devotee who has taken refuge at His feet (maharaj- if knowledge is there then death cannot come. First knowledge should go off then death can come). 9ie. desire, anger etc. qualities of space and mind

owis.original: देव भक्तांचा कैवारी । देव पतितांसि तारी । देव होये साहाकारी । अनाथांचा ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव हा भक्तांवर कृपा करणारा आहे. देव पतितांचा उद्धार करणारा आहे. देव हा अनाथांचा सहाय्यकर्ता आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: God is the protector of the devotee; God saves those who had fallen into this gross body; God becomes the companion of the orphan (one who does not know their true mother/mula maya and father/mula purush).

owis.original: देव अनाथांचा कैपक्षी । नाना संकटांपासून रक्षी । धाविन्नला अंतरसाक्षी । गजेंद्राकारणें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव हा अनाथांचा पक्ष घेणारा आहे. तो त्यांना अनेक संकटांतून वाचवितो. गजेन्द्राला मगरीच्या तावडींतून सोडविण्यासाठी तो तत्काल धावला.
owis.englishMeaning: God gives His support to that orphan and protects him from the `many' calamities. When gajendra, the elephant was caught by the crocodile (ie. ego), God Himself ran to save him; for God is also that Witness within this inner space (therefore understand this `all' and He will be ever present, watching over you).

owis.original: देव कृपेचा सागरु । देव करुणेचा जळधरु । देवासि भक्तांचा विसरु । पडणार नाहीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव हा कृपेचा सागर आहे. तो करुणारुपी मेघ आहे. देवाला भक्तांचा कधीच विसर पडत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: God is the ocean of grace; God is the cloud of compassion; God will never forget His devotee.

owis.original: देव प्रीती राखों जाणे । देवासी करावें साजणें । जिवलगें आवघी पिसुणें । कामा न येती ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या भक्ताचे प्रेम कसे राखावें त्याला प्रेमांकित कसा करावा. व त्याचे प्रेम कसे वृधिंगत करावे. हे सर्व देवाला माहीत आहे. म्हणून देवाशी खर्‍या भावनेने सख्यत्व करा. आपले नातेवाईक हे स्वार्थ बुद्धिने जमा होतात. प्रसंगी आपल्या सहाय्यास येत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: God knows how to protect love. So, God should be made your beloved. He is your most beloved and He wipes away the desires within your mind.

owis.original: सख्य देवाचें तुटेना । प्रीती देवाची विटेना । देव कदा पालटेना । शरणागतांसी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाशी सख्य जोडले की ते तुटत नाही. देवाचे प्रेम कमी होत नाही. ते वाढतच जाते. देव शरणागताला कधी निराश करत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: God never breaks His friendship. God's love never wanes. God never turns away from those who have surrendered to Him.

owis.original: म्हणोनि सख्य देवासी करावें । हितगुज तयासी सांगावें । आठवे भक्तीचें जाणावें । लक्षण ऐसें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून देवाशी सख्य, मैत्री खर्‍या भवनेने करावी. त्याल आपले सर्व सुख-दुःख सांगावे. आठव्या भक्तीचे हे असे लक्षण जाणून घ्यावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore your friendship should be with God only. And then this concealed `I am' 10His name was gajendra and he was the King of elephants and a great devotee of vishnu. should become that thoughtless, I do not exist. This `I am' should be known as this attention of the eighth devotion.

owis.original: जैसा देव तैसा गुरु । शास्त्रीं बोलिला हा विचारु । म्हणौन सख्यत्वाचा प्रकारु । सद्गुरुसीं असावा ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जसा देव तसाच सद्गुरु असे शास्त्रांत सांगितले आहे. म्हणुन सख्यत्व सद्गुरुशी ही याचप्रकारे करावे.
owis.englishMeaning: God and the guru are both the same. Within the shasthras (neti, neti) there is this speech `I am' and that understanding, I do not exist. Therefore this kind of friendship should be made with sadguru. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां जालें निरुपण । आठवे भक्तीचें लक्षण । आतां ऐका सावधान । भक्ति नवमी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागच्या समासांत आठवी भक्ती कशी त्याचे वर्णन केले. आतां सावधपणें नवव्या भक्तीचे वर्णन ऐका.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously this eighth devotion had been discoursed. Now, listen attentively and there will be the ninth devotion.

owis.original: नवमी निवेदन जाणावें । आत्मनिवेदन करावें । तें हि सांगिजेल स्वभावें । प्रांजळ करुनि ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निवेदनाला नववी भक्ती म्हणतात. आपण सर्वस्वी स्वतःला भगवंताकडे सोपविणे. म्हणजे आत्मनिवेदन. त्याच्या ताब्यांत देणे किंवा स्वतःला देवाच्या हाती सोपविणे.
owis.englishMeaning: The ninth devotion should be known as surrender; it is the offering of this `I' to that atma. Then this spontaneous `all' will become that Reality.

owis.original: ऐका निवेदन लक्षण । देवासि वाहावें आपण । करावें तत्वविवरण । म्हणिजे कळे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वतःला देवाला वाहाणे ही निवेदनाची खूण आहे. तत्वाचा शोध घेतल्यावर जे उरते ते म्हणजेच मी हा देवाला ममत्व सोडून वाहून टाकणे.
owis.englishMeaning: Listen to this `I am', for this attention brings about that surrender. In this way, you should be offered to God. When the gross elements are carefully examined then, that Reality can be understood.

owis.original: मी भक्त ऐसें म्हणावें । आणी विभक्तपणें भजावें । हें आवघेंचि जाणावें । विलक्षण ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मी भक्त आहे आहे असे एकीकडे म्हणायचे आणी दुसरीकडे वेगळेपणा धरुन भगवंताची भक्ती करायची. यामधिल विरोधाभास विलक्षण वाटतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If you say, `I am a devotee' and make bhajans by remaining separate then, you should know that, that thoughtless Self has become something else created by your mind.

owis.original: लक्षण असो विलक्षण । ज्ञान असोन अज्ञान । भक्त असोन विभक्तपण । तें हें ऐसें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणजे एकीकडे एखादे लक्षण आहे असे म्हणायचे व दुसरीकडे तें लक्षण नाही असे वागायचे. किंवा एखाद्याला ज्ञान आहे असे म्हणायचे व दुसरीकडे तें ज्ञान नाही असे वागायचे. त्यामुळे लक्षण आहे व लक्षण नाही, किंवा ज्ञान व अज्ञान या गोष्टी एकावेळी असू शकत नाहीत. त्याचप्रमाणे एखादा माणुस एकाचवेळी भक्त व विभक्त असू शकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is an attention and something has appeared; then you are knowledge and this is ignorance; then though being a devotee, you are remaining separate and that thoughtless Reality becomes like that only.

owis.original: भक्त म्हणिजे विभक्त नव्हे । आणी विभक्त म्हणिजे भक्त नव्हे । विचारेंविण कांहींच नव्हे । समाधान ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्त हा भगवंतापासून वेगळा नाही. व जो भगवंतापासून वेगळा आहे तो भक्त नव्हे. परंतु आत्मानात्म विचार केल्याखेरीज या गोष्टी समाधानकारक रीतीने समजणार नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: A devotee truly means, not separate; and separateness means there is no devo- tion. Without the understanding of no-otherness, this `all' cannot have that complete contentment/samadhan of Reality. (That thoughtless understanding of no-otherness is devotion/bhakti )

owis.original: तस्मात विचार करावा । देव कोण तो वोळखावा । आपला आपण शोध घ्यावा । अंतर्यामीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून विचार करुन देव कोण ते ओळखावे. आपला आपणच आपल्या अंतरी शोध घ्यावा. आणी जाणून घ्यावे.
owis.englishMeaning: You should be thoughtless and then can God, that atma, be recognized. Therefore you should search within yourself.

owis.original: मी कोण ऐसा निवाडा । पाहों जातां तत्वझाडा । विचार करितां उघडा । आपण नाहीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मी कोण आहे हा साधा प्रश्ण वाटतो. पण याच्या मागच्या तत्वाचा विचार करायला लागल्यावर जो " मी " आपण समजतो तो खरा " मी " नाही असे समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: `Who am I?' This should be determined. This understanding can only come about when the gross elements are negated (so first determine that you are this `I am' beyond the gross elements) and when that thoughtless understanding is clearly grasped then, you are not (that thoughtless understanding is offering yourself to the atma).

owis.original: तत्वें तत्व जेच्हां सरे । तेव्हां आपण कैंचा उरे । आत्मनिवेदन येणें प्रकारें । सहजचि जालें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका तत्वाने दुसर्‍या तत्वाचे निरसन होत नाही. तेव्हां आपण निराळे उरत नाही. अशारीतीने तत्वनिरसनाने आत्मनिवेदन सहजच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When one gross element is negated by another element then, how can you remain? In this way, there is naturally the offering of yourself to that atma.

owis.original: तत्वरुप सकळ भासे । विवेक पाहातां निरसे । प्रकृतिनिरासें आत्मा असे । आपण कैंचा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळे दृश्य विश्र्व पंचमहाभूतांचे बनलेले आहे. त्यांचे विवेकानें विवरण केले तर सर्वांचा निरास होतो. म्हणजे ती शेवटपर्यंत खरेपणाने टिकत नाहीत. अशारीतीने दृश्य विश्र्वाचे अथवा प्रकृतीचे निरसन झालें की आत्मस्वरुपच शिल्लक उरते. मग आपला मी वेगळा राहातच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The elemental forms and this `all' have appeared but when you understand through vivek then, they are cast off. When that atma casts off its prakruti, how can there be this `I'?

owis.original: येक मुख्य परमेश्र्वरु । दुसरी प्रकृति जगदाकारु । तिसरा आपण कैंचा चोरु । आणिला मधें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुख्य मुलतत्वे दोनच आहेत. एक परमेश्र्वर व दुसरी विश्र्वाचा आकार त्या दोघांमध्ये तिसरा " मी " हा चोर येतच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that One Supreme parameshwara and the other is prakruti, this world form.11 Then from where has this third, the thief `I', come in between?

owis.original: ऐसें हें सिद्धचि असतां । नाथिली लागे देहअहंता । परंतु विचारें पाहों जातां । कांहींच नसे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परमात्मा आणी प्रकृती हीं दोन मूलतत्वें स्वतः सिद्ध आहेत. परंतु मुळांत नसलेला आणी या कारणासाठी खोटा असलेला देहाहंकार आपल्याला चिकटतो. तरीपण विचारानें शोध घेतल्यास त्याला कांही आधार नाही असा निश्र्चय होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Only that thoughtless Self is real and that has acquired a body ego/ahamta which is not. But if due to that thoughtless understanding, you come to understand that Reality then even this `all' is not.

owis.original: पाहातां तत्वविवंचना । पिंडब्रह्मांडतत्वरचना । विश्र्वाकारें वेक्ती नाना । तत्वें विस्तारलीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: व्यक्ति आणि विश्र्व यांमधील तत्वांची रचना शोधून पाहिली, त्याचप्रमाणें तत्वांची मीमांसा करुन पाहिली तर असे आढळते की, या विश्र्वामधील अनेक प्रकारचे अगणित आकार किंवा दृश्य वस्तु हा सगळा तत्वांचाच विस्तार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When the elements are investigated then it is understood that, the body/pinda and the created universe/brahmanda are both elemental constructions. These `many' forms/pinda are the expansion of the gross elements in this visible creation/brahmanda (the `many' names and forms are created when the intellect regards itself as a separate entity in this whole created world).

owis.original: तत्वें साक्षत्वें वोसरती । साक्षत्व नुरे आत्मप्रचिती । आत्मा असे आदिअंतीं । आपण कैंचा ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या देहासकट या विश्र्वाकडे आपण साक्षित्वाने पाहूं लागलो, म्हणजे केवळ बघणार्‍याची भूमिका ठेवून तिर्‍हाईतपणाने पाहूं लागलो तर ती तत्वें सहज नाहीशी होतात. नंतर प्रत्यक्ष आत्म्याचा अनुभव आला कीं साक्षीपणाही उरत नाही. विश्र्वाच्या आरंभी केवळ आत्माच होता तसाच विश्र्वाच्या शेवटीसुद्धा आत्माच शिल्लक राहतो. हें जर खरे तर आपल्या मीपणाला वेगळें अस्तित्व राहातच नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: But due to witnessing these gross elements are dissolved. And when there is the direct experience of the atma then, even witnessing does not remain (when no-otherness is understood, how can there be a Witness?). When from beginning to the end, there is only that atma, then how can there be an `I'?

owis.original: आत्म एक स्वानंदघन । आणी अहमात्मा हें वचन । तरी मग आपण कैंचा भिन्न । उरला तेथें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा सगळीकडे व्यापून आहे. आपल्या आनंदानें तो संपूर्ण भरलेला आहे. आणि मीच तो आत्मा आहे असे श्रुति सांगते. तर " मी " आणखी कोणी निराळा असू शकत नाही. म्हणून देहाचा अहंकार खोटा आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that One atma full of its own bliss and when there is this `I am atma' thought then, that thoughtless swarup has become this divine `word' (`I am'). But how can this separate `I' remain `there' in brahman?

owis.original: सोहं हंसा हें उत्तर । याचें पाहावें अर्थांतर । पाहातां आत्मयाचा विचार । आपण कैंचा तेथें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " कोऽहम् " या प्रश्र्णाचे उत्तर " सोऽहम् " " मी कोण " याप्रश्र्णाचे उत्तर " तो मी " आहे. या उत्तरामध्ये असणारा सर्व अर्थ उकलून पहावा. आत्म्याच्या विचारांत शिरले कीं " मी " आणखी कोणी निराळा आहे हे सिद्ध होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is soham hamsa (`I am That') then, that thoughtless Self has become this `I am'. Therefore the inner meaning of this `I am' should be understood. When that thoughtlessness of the atma is understood then, how can `I' be `there'?

owis.original: आत्मा निर्गुण निरंजन । तयासी असावें अनन्य । अनन्य म्हणिजे नाहीं अन्य । आपण कैंचा तेथें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सोऽहम् म्हणजे तो आत्मा मी आहे. आत्मा निर्गुण व निरंजन म्हणजे दृश्याच्या पलीकडे व मलरहित आहे. मी तोच असल्याने त्याच्याशी अनन्य आहे. अनन्य म्हणजे मी व तो वेगळे नाही. हें जर खरे तर " मी " कोणी निराळा आहे असे कसे म्हणता येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is nirgun and niranjan (beyond knowledge). There should be this no- otherness of that Reality and when there is no-otherness then, how can `I' be `there'?

owis.original: आत्मा म्हणिजे तो अद्वैत । जेथे नाहीं द्वैताद्वैत । तेथें मीपणाचा हेत । उरेल कैंचा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा अद्वैत आहे, अद्वैत म्हणजे द्वैत नाहीं तें, ज्यांत दुसरेपणा नाहीं तें. असें जर आहे तर आणखी वेगळ्या " मी "पणाचे कारण असूंच शकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma means non-duality/adwait. Then `here' (maya) the discrimination be- tween duality and non-duality, no longer remains then, how can this original intent of `I am' remain `there' (in brahman)? (non-duality can only be spoken of in the context of duality, like sagun and nirgun. But when there is only One then such discrimination can no longer remain).

owis.original: आत्मा पूर्णत्वें परिपूर्ण । जेथें नाहीं गुणागुण । निखळ निर्गुण आपण । कोण कैंचा ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा सर्व बाजूंनी परिपूर्ण आहे. तो मूर्तिमंत पूर्णता आहे. तेथें गुण व अवगुण दोन्हीही नाहीत. मानवी बुद्धिला गुणांवाचून वस्तूची कल्पनाच करता येत नाही. म्हणुन सर्व अनात्मवस्तु आपण सगुण म्हणतो. पण आत्मवस्तु मानवी कल्पनांच्या पलीकडे असल्याने आपण तिला निर्गुण म्हणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma, due to its completeness, is full and complete. Then any discrimination between gunas and without-gunas `here' can no longer remain. Then how can there be this `I' in that pure nirgun?

owis.original: त्वंपद तत्पद असिपद । निरसुनि सकळ भेदाभेद । वस्तु ठाईंची अभेद । आपण कैंचा ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " तत् त्वम् असि " म्हणजे " तूं ते ब्रह्म आहेस " असें उपनिषदांतील स्वानुभवाचे वाक्य आहे. या तिनही पदांच्या पलिकडे असलेल्या आत्मस्वरुपापर्यंत जो पोहोचला, त्याला भेद व अभेद दोन्ही लटके होतात. त्याला मी देह आहे अशी मीपणाची निराळी अवस्था कशी असणार ? म्हणून मीपणाअसत्य आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When the state `you'/twa, the state `That'/tat and the state `to be'/asi (tattwamasi `That you are') are dissolved then, the discrimination between different and non- different is also dissolved. When there is that original Self, void of difference, then how can there be this `I' of the `all'?

owis.original: निरसितां जीवशिवउपाधी । जीवशिवचि कैंचे आधीं । स्वरुपीं होतां दृढबुद्धि । आपण कैंचा ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मी जीव आहे व तो शिव आहे. हा विद्याअविद्यांनी निर्माण केलेला भेद आहे. त्या भेदाची उपाधि नाहींशी केली तर आत्मस्वरुपांत जीवशिव असा भेद नाही हे लक्षांत येईल. असा निश्र्चय झाला की मी राहणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When the limiting concepts of jiva and shiva are both gone, then how can any discri- mination between the jiva and shiva begin? When the conviction of the intellect/buddhi is fixed within that swarup, then where is this `I'?

owis.original: आपण मिथ्यासाच देव । देव भक्त अनन्यभाव । या वचनाचा अभिप्राव । अनुभवीन जाणती ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी देह आहे " या भावनेमुळे आपण कोणी निराळे आहोत, स्वतंत्र आहोत, असा जो आपला दृढ विश्र्वास असतो, तो भ्रम असतो. तो असत्य आहे. एक भगवंत काय तो खरा आहे. तसेच भक्त व भगवंत दोघे निराळे दिसले तरी ते वेगळे नसतात. दोघे एकमेकाशी अनन्य असतात. एकरुप असतात. हे जे मी (समर्थ) सांगतो त्याचा अर्थ फक्त स्वानुभवी पुरुषांनाच कळेल.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I' is false and God is true. When God is the *devotee then there is the understanding of no-otherness.12 This divine `word' has meaning only to the Knower of this `word' (but in no-otherness this `word' and its Knower no longer remain).

owis.original: या नाव आत्मनिवेदन । ज्ञानियांचे समाधान । नवमे भक्तीचें लक्षण । निरोपिलें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्तानें आपला संपूर्ण मीपणा भगवंताला वाहणें आणि त्याच्याशी संपूर्णपणे एकरुप होऊन जाणें यास आत्मनवेदन असे म्हणतात. आत्मनिवेदनानेच ज्ञानी पुरुषांना समाधान लाभते. याप्रमाणे नवव्या भक्तीचे लक्षण निरोपिले.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `name' (`I am') is offered to that atma (I do not exist) then, there is the complete contentment of the gnyani. Thus the ninth devotion has been discoursed.

owis.original: पंचभूतांमध्यें आकाश । सकळ देवांमध्यें जगदीश । नवविधा भक्तिमधें विशेष । भक्ति नवमी ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याप्रमाणे पंचमहाभूतांमध्यें आकाश, सगळ्या देवांमध्ये जगदिश श्रेष्ठ, त्याचप्रमाणें भक्तीचे जे नऊ प्रकार सांगितले त्यामध्यें नववी म्हणजे आत्मनिवेदन भक्ति सर्वांत श्रेष्ठ भक्ति आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the five elements there is space/akash; within the three gunas there is this `all' and that `Lord of the all', the atma. Within the nine devotions, this ninth devotion is the greatest for it reveals that Lord.

owis.original: नवमी भक्ति आत्मनिवेदन । न होतां न चुके जन्ममरण । हें वचन सत्य प्रमाण । अन्यथा नव्हे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नववी भक्ति जी आर्मनिवेदन ती जर साधली नाही तर माणसाचें, भक्ताचे जन्ममरण चुकणार नाही, हे माझे बोलणे अगदी खरे आहे, अनुभवाला धरुन आहे, तें खोटे होणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The ninth devotion is the offering of this `I' to the atma; if this is not achieved then, birth and death cannot be avoided. If there is this divine `word' then, that thoughtless Truth can be established, otherwise not.

owis.original: ऐसी हे नवविधा भक्ती । केल्यां पाविजे सायोज्यमुक्ती । सायोज्यमुक्तीस कल्पांतीं । चळण नाहीं ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नवविधा भक्ति ही अशी आहे. ती आचरली तर सायुज्यमुक्ति मिळते. या सबंध विश्र्वाचा लय झाला तरी सायुज्यमुक्ति अचल राहते. तिच्यामध्यें बदल होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is that thoughtless ninth devotion. Through this one will attain Final Liberation/sayujya-mukti. That Final Liberation is within the `end of thought' and it never moves.

owis.original: तिहीं मुक्तीस आहे चळण । सायोज्यमुक्ती अचळ जाण । त्रैलोक्यास होतां निर्वाण । सायोज्यमुक्ती चळेना ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकंदर मुक्ति चार आहेत. त्यापैकी पहिल्या तीन मुक्तींमध्ये फरक घडून येतो. सायुज्यमुक्ति मात्र अचल राहते, तिच्यांत फरक पडत नाही. तिन्ही लोकांचा शेवट झाला तरी सायुज्यमुक्तिमध्यें कोणताही फेरबदल होत नाही ती जशीच्या तशीच कायम राहते.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the three other liberations there is movement. Know that Final Liberation is steady. When the *three worlds have been destroyed there is that Final Liberation and it does not move. *(Waking, dream and deep sleep states)

owis.original: आवघीया चत्वार मुक्ती । वेदशास्त्रें बोलती । तयामधें तीन नासती । चौथी ते अविनाश ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेद व शास्त्रे यांनी एकंदर चार प्रकारच्या मुक्ति वर्णन केल्या आहेता. त्यापैंकी तीन नश्वर आहेत. अशाश्वत आहेत. पण चौथी मात्र शाश्वत आहे. अविनाशी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There are four liberations according to the veda and shasthras. In that Reality, three get destroyed but the fourth is indestructible.

owis.original: पहिली मुक्ती ते स्वलोकता । दुसरी ते समीपता । तिसरी ते स्वरुपता । चौथी सायोज्यमुक्ती ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पहिली मुक्ति स्वलोकता, दुसरी समीपता, तिसरी स्वरुपता आणि चौथी सायोज्यमुक्ती होय.
owis.englishMeaning: The first liberation, this is salokata, to be a `devotee of God'; the second, this is samipata, to be `in heaven with God'; the third, this is sarupata, `I and God are the same'; and fourth, this is sayujyata mukti, I do not exist (as explained by maharaj).

owis.original: ऐसिया चत्वार मुक्ती । भगवद्भजनें प्राणी पावती । हेंचि निरुपण प्रांजळ श्रोतीं । सावध पुढें परिसावें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा या चार मुक्ति भगवंताच्या भक्तीनें माणसाला त्या प्राप्त होतात. पुढील समासी हाच विषय सांगावयाचा आहे. श्रोत्यांनी ते सावधपणें ऐकावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Such are four liberations. They are attained by the one within the prana, when these nine bhajans of God are made. That thoughtless non-dual discourse within the listener becomes clear, when you listen very carefully ahead. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Mukti Chatushtaya (The Four Kinds of Liberation)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मुळी ब्रह्म निराकार । तेथें स्फूर्तिरुप अहंकार । तो पंचभूतांचा विचार । ज्ञानदशकीं बोलिला ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुळांत ब्रह्म अव्यक्त व आकाररहित आहे. तेथें ही व्यक्त व साकार सृष्टी वगैरे कांही नसतें व नव्हतें. त्या निरागस ब्रह्मामध्यें एक स्फुरण उद्भवले तो अहंकार होय. त्यांतून पंचभूतात्मक सृष्टि निर्माण झाली. ती कशी झाली त्याचा विचार ज्ञानदशकांत म्हणजे आठव्या दशकांत केला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the *root there is that formless brahman. That brahman `there' has appeared as this original inspiration or ahamkar/`I am'. Then that thoughtless Self became the five great elements and this speech `I am' gets hidden within the knowledge of the ten senses (ie. body consciousness). *(The root of this creation is prakruti/purush ie. that formless purush knowing this original form. `Here' the gunas and elements are unmanifest and when they become manifest, our world of names and forms appears)

owis.original: तो अहंकार वायोरुप । तयावरी तेजाचें स्वरुप ।ते तया तेजाच्या आधारें आप। आवर्णोदकदाटलें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें अहंकाराचे स्फुरण वायुसारखे शक्तीरुप असते. त्यातून तेज प्रगटते. व त्या तेजाच्या आधारे सगळीकडे पाणी भरुन गेले.
owis.englishMeaning: When that brahman is this ahamkar it gets called the wind element. And then upon that swarup there appears the great fire element. Then that brahman, due to the support of this fire, becomes the great water element and this surrounding, controlling water covers everywhere (This metaphor of the five elements is used to explain this process called objectification, where the subject becomes the object or simply imagination. When that formless brahman tries to see itself then, it sees its reflection and the sense of `I am' appears.13 This is also known as the wind element. Not satisfied with this, if it takes a little step further out then, there is the appearance of something outside of its self. This is called the fire element. And as it becomes more objective, objects appear `softly'. This is the water element; it is like a wave arising out of the sea. At this point, along with the appearance of distinct forms there is a sense of individuality. And if our attention or our focus gets placed upon an object for any length of time then, that object `stands out' from all that is being seen or heard etc. It appears as if out of no-where. And as the habit of the mind is to think over and over about these objects perceived through the senses, they appear completely gross/solid and real ie. earth element. This process happens every morning when we awake but because we have no knowledge of it, it escapes our notice. This is why maharaj advised us to wake up slowly; to catch this process. Thus in That which is formless like space, there appears form, the elements, the mind and an objective world).14

owis.original: तया आवर्णोदकाच्या आधारें । धरा धरिली फणिवरें । वरती छपन्न कोटी विस्तारें । वसुंधरा हे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या पाण्याच्या आधारे शेषाने आपल्या मस्तकावर पृथ्वी उचलून धरली. छपन्न कोटी योजने इतका पृथ्वीचा विस्तार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: With the support of these waters of objectification, that great divine serpent/shesha* upholds the earth. In this way, that thoughtless Reality has expanded into 56 divisions and a world has been created (56: 25 subtle and 25 gross elemental divisions, four bodies, ignorance and knowledge; see 17.8). *(shesha means that which remains when everything is given up. He cannot be given up, for He is the indestructible atma purush; and as the Witness, He is said to be the serpent on which vishnu ie. knowledge, rests. He is said to have 1000 heads and on one of these heads, the world, your world is held. In this way vishnu/knowledge has expanded and become the `many' worlds; each mind is one of these worlds)

owis.original: इयेवरी परीघ सप्त सागर । मध्य मेरु माहां थोर । अष्ट दिग्पाळ तो परिवार । अंतरें वेष्टित राहिला ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तिच्या भोवती सात सागरांचा वेढा आहे. मध्यें मोठा प्रचंड मेरु पर्वत आहे. आठ दिशापालकांचा हे सगळे अंतर वेढून आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: On this earth there are 7 seas and in the centre of this earth there is mountain meru (`I am'). It remains in the middle and the 8 lords of the 8 directions encompass this surrounding space. (The 7 seas are the dhatus of the body, skin, marrow, bone etc.; but when meru is understood then in all 8 directions, space is there ie. no things are there ie. neti, neti)

owis.original: तो सुवर्णाचा माहा मेरु । पृथ्वीस तयाचा आधारु । चौर्‍यासी सहस्त्र विस्तारु । रुंदी तयाची ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो प्रचंड मेरु पर्वत सोन्याचा आहे. पृथ्वीला तो आधार देतो. चौर्‍यांशी हजार योजने त्याची रुंदी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: meru mountain is made of gold and it is the support of this earth (this earth is the last of the five great elements and the beginning of gross body consciousness due to the mixing together of these elements ie. first there was subtle objectification and names and forms started to appear, then afterwards further concepts get added ie. pain/pleasure, good/bad etc. and there is gross body consciousness). Then this earth expanded into the 84 laksha of jiva and the countless objects (laksha means one hundred thousand but it also means attention; and due to this objective attention there comes the 84 principles that make up the gross body; see 17.8)

owis.original: उंच तरी मर्यादेवेगळा । भूमीमधें सहस्त्र सोळा । तया भोवता वेष्टित पाळा । लोकालोक पर्वताचा ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याची उंची मोजणे शक्य नाही. तो भूमीच्या आंत सोळा हजार योजने गेला आहे. रक्षणासाठी त्याच्या भोवती लोकालोक पर्वताचा वेढा आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That paramatma is without any boundary or limit but in this world it extends to *16 thousand yoganas and becomes limited. Then the lokaloka mountains are assembled and they enwrap that Reality (loka means worldly; aloka is transcending the worldly ie. prakruti/purush). *(16 means the 5 pranas, 5 organs of knowledge, 5 organs of action and mind)

owis.original: तया ऐलिकडे हिमाचळ । जेथें पांडव गळाले सकळ । धर्म आणि तमाळनीळ । पुढें गेले ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या अलीकडे हिमालय आहे. तेथे सर्व पांडव गळून पडले. फक्त धर्म व यमदेव दोघेच पुढे गेले.
owis.englishMeaning: The himalayas are on this side of that paramatma and this is where the pandavas fell one by one, except dharma and shri krishna who went ahead. (himalaya is the causal body or ignorance; pandavas are the great elements, dharma is the eldest brother or space or knowledge and krishna is the Master. They go beyond this ignorance of sleep or nothingness)

owis.original: जेथें जावया मार्ग नाहीं । मार्गी पसरले माहा अही । सितसुखें सुखावले ते हि । पर्वतरुप भासती ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हिमालयांतून जायला वाट नाही. कारण वाटेमध्यें प्रचंड सर्प पसरलेले आहेत. बर्फाच्या थंडपणाने आराम करणारे ते सर्प पर्वतासारखे दिसतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There is no way to get to this `I am', for great snakes are asleep on the path. They are lazy due to the cold (ie. ignorance) and appear like great mountains (ie. the great snakes are desires sleeping/hidden in the causal body and the mountains represent concepts).

owis.original: तया ऐलिकडे सेवटीं जाण । बद्रिकाश्रम बद्रिनारायण । तेथें माहां तापसी निर्वाण । देहत्यागार्थ जाती ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या अलीकडे टोकाला बद्रिकाश्रम व बद्रिनारायण आहेत. मोठे मोठे तपस्वी मोक्ष मिळवण्याच्या इच्छेने देह ठेवण्यास तेथे जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: On this side nearer to meru there is badri-narayana and badrik-ashram, where great ascetics do penance before complete relinquishment of their bodies (those devotees who have not yet completely given up body consciousness).

owis.original: तया ऐलिकडे बद्रिकेदार । पाहोन येती लाहान थोर । ऐसा हा अवघा विस्तार । मेरुपर्वताचा ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या अलीकडे बद्रिकेदार आहे. लहानथोर सगळे तें पाहून येतात. असा हा मेरु पर्वताचा सगळा विस्तार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: badri-kedar is nearer. While contemplating that place, the small jiva becomes the great brahman. But due to the expansion of this meru mountain, that thoughtless Self has become the many things of the mind.

owis.original: तया मेरुपर्वता पाठारीं । तीन श्रृंगे विषमहारी । परिवारें राहिले तयावरी । ब्रह्म विष्णु महेश ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या मेरुपर्वताच्या पठारावर वाकड्यातिकड्या दिशांना तीन शिखरें आहेत. ब्रह्मा, विष्णु व महेश आपल्या परिवारासह तेथे राहतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are three peaks on a plateau of this meru mountain; upon that the gods brahma, vishnu and mahesh stay and they expand from there (ie. from this knowledge `I am' there appears the three gunas; maharaj- rajo guna is thinking...what is this? You ask because you don't know/tamo guna, but you ask with knowledge/sattwa guna. Mixture is there).

owis.original: ब्रह्मश्रृंग तो पर्वताचा । विष्णुश्रृंग तो मर्गजाचा । शिवश्रृंग तो स्फटिकाचा । कैळास नाम त्याचें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मा राहतो तें शिखर साधे दगडाचे आहे. विष्णु राहतो ते शिखर पाचूचे आहे. आणि शंकर राहतो ते शिखर स्फटिकाचे आहे. त्याला कैलास म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The peak of brahma is of stone; the peak of vishnu is of mixed alloy gold; the peak of shiva is a crystal and it is called kailas. (meru is gold, brahma's abode is solid and objective; vishnu's abode is mixed alloy gold ie. appears similar to gold; mahesh's abode is kailas- kaya/body, laya/dissolve, asne/to be ie. the dissolution of the body)

owis.original: वैकुंठ नाम विष्णुश्रृंगाचे । सत्यलोक नाम ब्रह्मश्रृंगाचें । अमरावती इंद्राचें । स्थळ खालतें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वैकुंठ हे विष्णुच्या शिखराचे नांव आहे. ब्रह्मा राहतो त्या शिखराचे नांव सत्यलोक आहे. त्याच्या खाली अमरावती नावाचे इंद्राचे ठिकाण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The peak of vishnu has the name vaikuntha; and satyalok is the name of brahma's peak; and amaravati is the name of the place of indra, the lord of the senses, below these three. (vaikuntha- where the third speech is obstructed ie. concepts are not for- med/created; satyalok- the world that is taken as true; amarvati; amar-immortal and vati-this side of)

owis.original: तेथे गण गंधर्व लोकपाळ । तेतिस कोटी देव सकळ । चौदा लोक सुवर्णाचळ । वेष्टित राहिले ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें गण, गंधर्व, लोकपाळ, सगळे तेहतीस कोटी देव राहतात. सप्तस्वर्ग व सप्तपाताल असे चौदा लोक मेरुपर्वतावर वसलेले आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: There is brahman `there' and there are gana and gandharva and the regents of every direction; there is this `all' and there are the 33 divisions of gods; then there are the 14 worlds encompassing that space around this golden mountain. (gana means counting, then that One gets divided and there are the beings of gandha ie. that is an imagined world in the sky or simply imagination. 33 means 25 subtle division of the elements and 5 elements and 3 gunas. The 14 worlds are the 5 organs of the senses and 5 organs of action, the mind, intellect/buddhi, chitta and ego) Note: these verses explain in a rather cryptic fashion, the nature of creation and the forms of bondage that have to be transcended if Final Liberation is to be attained. We have to leave the thought of being a gross body; we have to leave the thought of `all' or `I am' by maintaining the detachment of the Witness of this `all'. And finally we have to be that ever liberated brahman)

owis.original: तेथें कामधेनूचीं खिलांरें । कल्पतरुचीं वनें अपारें । अमृताचीं सरोवरें । ठाईं ठाईं उचंबळली ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथे कामधेनूंचे मोठे कळप आहेत. कल्पवृक्षांची पुष्कळ वने आहेत. ठिकठिकाणी अमृताने भरलेली सरोवरे उचंबळत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There is brahman `there' and the flocks of divine cows/kamadhenu; on account of that limitless paramatma there are the forests of wish-fulfilling trees/kalpataru and the lakes of immortal nectar overflowing at every place (ie. knowledge; when that limitless brahman becomes this knowledge then whatever it wishes will happen; if it thinks it is a body then, you become a body).

owis.original: तेथें उदंड चिंतामणी । हिरे परिसांचिया खाणी । तेथें सुवर्णमये धरणी । लखलखायमान ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें खूप चिंतामणी आहेत. हिर्‍यांच्या व परिसांच्या खाणी आहेत. तेथील सोन्याची जमीन लखलखाट करतअसते.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that vast paramatma `there' and there are the mines of chintamani and diamonds and paris stones. brahman has appeared as this world of the `all', brightly shining like gold and then this appears as this earth. (chintamani- a stone believed to relieve worry and thought ie. `I am'; the paris stone is said to turn iron into gold ie. `I am').

owis.original: परम रमणीये फांकती किळा । नवरत्नाचिया पाषाणसिळा । तेथें अखंड हरुपवेळा । आनंदमये ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें नवरत्नांच्या पाषाणशिला आहेत. त्यांची अतिशय सुंदर प्रभा आजुबाजुला फाकते. तेथे सदासर्वदा आनंद भरलेला असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that Supreme and there are the `many' precious stones (ie. we give them their value, but it is all imagined; maharaj- what does a dog care for these? It wants a bone) or there are the nine jewels of the nine devotions that sparkle brightly giving out the light which are very pleasing to behold. Then that unbroken brahman `there' is this time of ecstatic bliss (ie. `I am').

owis.original: तेथें अमृताचीं भोजनें । दिव्य गंधें दिव्य सुमनें । अष्टनायका गंधर्वगायनें । निरंतर ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या ठिकाणी भोजन अमृताचे असते. दिव्य सुवास असलेली दिव्य फुले असतात. अष्टनायिका व गंधर्व यांचे गायन सारखें चालू असते.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that brahman `there' and the enjoyment of the immortal nectar; it is the divine fragrance of divine flowers (ie. the pure experience of a pure mind). There is the eight lords of the eight directions (ie. space), there is the singing by the gandharvas and there is that nirantar/`without an inner space' (there is this pervading `all', the imagined world and that which is `without an inner space'/parabrahman).

owis.original: तेथें तारुण्य वोसरेना । रोगव्याधी हि असेना । वृधाप्य आणी मरण येना । कदाकाळीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें तारुण्य कधींच कमी होत नाही. कोणाला रोग, व्याधी होत नाही. कोणाला म्हातारपण व मरण कधींच येत नाही.
