owis.englishMeaning: There is that brahman `there' and the youthfulness that never ends; where there is no sickness or disease (ie. no gross body); where there is no old age and the time of death never comes (maharaj- as long as knowledge is there death cannot come, first knowledge must go off and then death can come).

owis.original: तेथें येकाहूनि येक सुंदर । तेथें येकाहूनि येक चतुर । धीर उदार आणी शूर । मर्यादेवेगळे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथें एकापेक्षां एक सुंदर असतात. एकापेक्षा एक चतुर असतात. तसेंच ज्यांच्या धैर्याला, औदार्याला आणि शौर्याला कांही सीमा नाही असे लोक असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: From that One `there' has come this beautiful `all' and from that One `there' has come this wise `I am' and `here' patience, fortitude, resolve, openness and bravery have no limits. (This knowledge is second liberation, for it is the freedom from gross body consciousness but it does not remain)

owis.original: तेथें दिव्यदेह ज्योतिरुपें । विद्युलतेसारिखीं स्वरुपें । तेथें येश कीर्ति प्रतापें । सिमा सांडिली ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेथील देह दिव्य प्रकाशमय असतात. तेथील रुप विजेप्रमाणें लखलखणारे असते. यश, कीर्ति आणि प्रताप यांना तेथें कांहीं मर्यादा नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that brahman `there' (Final Liberation), on account of this divine body of the `all' and the light of knowledge (by remaining in knowledge, knowledge will itself go off). And there is this `all' body like the brilliance of lightning, on account of that swarup. However, in brahman these limits of success, pervasive and majesty are cast off (these are qualities of this `I am' liberation).

owis.original: ऐसे ते स्वर्गभुवन । सकळ देवांचें वस्तें स्थान । तया स्थळाचें महिमान । बोलिजे तितुकें थोडें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें स्वर्गभुवन असें आहे. सगळ्या देवांचे ते राहण्याचे ठिकाण आहे. त्या स्थळाचा महिमा सांगावा तेवढा थोडाच होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: When that Reality is this realm called heaven/swarga then, it is this `all' and this is the resting place of the gods/gunas (here the gunas are in equilibrium). The greatness of this `all' abode is understood by only a few.

owis.original: येथें ज्या देवाचें भजन करावें । तेथें ते देवलोकीं राहावें । स्वलोकता मुक्तीचें जाणावें । लक्षण ऐसें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या जगांत वास्तव्यांत ज्या देवाची उपासना केलेली असते. त्या देवाच्या लोकांत मृत्युनंतर राहावयास मिळते. सलोकता मुक्तीचे लक्षण असे आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But if `here' one makes the bhajans of the gods/guna then, that Reality `there', remains in the world of that gods/gunas. One should know that such an attention is salokata liberation.

owis.original: लोकीं राहावें ते स्वलोकता । समीप असावें ते समीपता । स्वरुप चि व्हावें ते स्वरुपता । तिसरी मुक्ती ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवलोकांत राहावयास मिळणें यास सलोकता म्हणतात. देवाच्या जवळ राहावयास मिळणें यांस समीपता म्हणतात. ही दुसरी मुक्ति होय. देवाचे रुपच आपल्याला यावे ही सरुपता, ही तिसरी मुक्ति होय.
owis.englishMeaning: You remain in this gross existence when that Reality has become salokata, (it is to be born a disciple and to be in the company of disciples). When you are in the proximity/samipa of God then, that Reality has become samipata liberation (`I am with God in heaven'; `I am He'/sagun). And to be that swarup of God then, that is sarupata liberation (nirgun; but that understanding is not established and one may fall back again into knowledge or gross existence).

owis.original: देवस्वरुप जाला देही । श्रीवत्स कौस्तुभ लक्ष्मी नाहीं । स्वरुपतेचें लक्षण पाहीं । ऐसें असे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उपासना करणार्‍यास देवाचें स्वरुप जरी प्राप्त झाले तरी श्रीवत्स कौस्तुभ व लक्ष्मी या गोष्टी त्याला मिळत नाहीत. सरुपता मुक्तीचें लक्षण असें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Even if you are that swarup of God within this `all', still goddess lakshmi (ie. `I am') is there and there is not that precious *shrivatsa (this is the mark on the chest of vishnu when a brahmin ie. Knower of brahman, called bhrugu, kicked him away. Means, He kicked off knowledge). In this way is the attention of sarupata to be understood. *(see 5.1.7. If knowledge is not forever kicked off then, one will return to this identification with being a body, this `I am' body or lakshmi, the consort of narayana)

owis.original: सुकृत आहे तों भोगिती । सुकृत सरता ढकलून देती । आपण देव ते असती । जैसे तैसे ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जोपर्यंत पुण्यसंचय असतो तोपर्यंत स्वर्गांत राहून तेथील सुखें भोगतां येतात. पण पुण्याई संपली की देव जीवाला खाली ढकलून देतात. देव मात्र कायम तेथेंच राहतात.
owis.englishMeaning: One enjoys the merit gained by proper action (ie. `He does everything') but still when this merit is exhausted then, one is pushed again outside (and falls back into knowledge; one has not disappeared, like the salt in the ocean and returns to the `all'). But when God Himself is that Reality then, He is just as He ever is (He has never lost Himself).

owis.original: म्हणोनि तिनी मुक्ति नासिवंत । सायोज्यमुक्ति ते शाश्वत । तेहि निरोपिजेल सावचित्त । ऐक आतां ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यामुळे तिन्ही मुक्ति नाशवंत आहेत. सायुज्यमुक्ति मात्र शाश्वत आहे. तिचे वर्णन आतां करतो. ते लक्षपूर्वक ऐक.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore, these three liberations are destructible, but this Final Liberation is in- destructible. That Final Liberation will be discoursed when you listen very carefully to this `now' (Forget everything, then only you/`I am' remain; then be so big that you disappear and do not exist, have never existed; forever free).

owis.original: ब्रह्मांड नासेल कल्पांतीं । पर्वतासहितजळेल क्षिती । तेव्हां अवघेच देव जाती । मां मुक्ति कैंच्या तेथें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पांताच्यावेळीं हें विश्र्व नाश पावते. पर्वतासकट पृथ्वी जळून जाते. त्यावेळी सर्व देव नाहींसे होतात. मग त्या संहारामध्यें पहिल्या तीन मुक्ति कशा टिकणार ?
owis.englishMeaning: At this time of dissolution through vivek, the brahmanda will be destroyed. This earth, along with the mountains (concepts) will be burnt. Though every thing and even the gods (brahma etc.; gunas) will have been destroyed still this `all' remains; so how can this be the liberation of `there'/Final Liberation?

owis.original: तेव्हां निर्गुण परमात्मा निश्र्चळ । निर्गुण भक्ति तेहि अचळ । सायोज्यमुक्ति ते केवळ । जाणिजे ऐसी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यावेळी निर्गुण परमात्मस्वरुप जसें आहे तसेंच निश्चल राहते. त्या निर्गुणाची भक्तीदेखील तशीच निश्चल राहते. सायुज्यमुक्ति ही अशी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Only when there is that still nirgun paramatma is there nirgun devotion and when that does not ever change then, that is sayujyata mukti/Final Liberation and that should be known as pure knowledge (maharaj- pure knowledge is no-knowledge).

owis.original: निर्गुणीं अनन्य असतां । तेणें होये सायोज्यता । सायोज्यता म्हणिजे स्वरुपता । निर्गुण भक्ती ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निर्गुण परमात्मस्वरुपाच्या ठिकाणी अनन्यपणें विलीन झालें कीं सायुज्यमुक्ति मिळते. स्वस्वरुपांत समरस होणें हीच निर्गुण भक्ति व हीच सायुज्यता समजावी.
owis.englishMeaning: In that nirgun there is no-otherness and by remaining in this there is sayujyata/Final Liberation. That sayujyata liberation should be called swarupta liberation when nirgun devotion remains (sayujyata liberation is the understanding that I was ever free and never bound; liberation and bondage, nirgun and sagun are both not. swarupta libe- ration is that nirgun devotion; it is not moving but it has not been forever established and gets broken; whereas sayujyata/Final Liberation can never be broken, just as the salt dissolved in the ocean is always the ocean).

owis.original: सगुण भक्ति ते चळे । निर्गुण भक्ति ते न चळे । हें आवघें प्रांजळ कळे । सद्गुरु केलियां ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगुण नाशवंत म्हणुन सगुण भक्ति नाशवंत असते. निर्गुण शाश्वत म्हणून निर्गुण भक्ति कायम टिकते. सद्गुरु केल्यानें हें सगळे स्पष्टपणें समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is sagun devotion (`I am everywhere') then, that Reality is moving. When there is nirgun devotion then, that Reality is not moving and therefore has no end. It is only through the grace of sadguru that, that thoughtless Reality is clearly understood. .
